name: Adroit Crafter

otherSummary.entry: Proficiency in a skill or tool

entries: You've trained in crafting items using a skill or tool that you're proficient with, and the steps in crafting have become second nature to you. You gain the following benefits:

items: The time it takes to create an item using your proficient skills or tools is halved.
If you fail to successfully craft the item and would lose the components, you retain the components instead.

name: Advanced Weapon Proficiency (FS)
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Weapon Proficiency
entries: You have proficiency with {@filter Advanced weapons|items|type=advanced weapon}, and your training allows you to use the mastery properties of those weapons.

name: Advanced Weapon Proficiency (G)
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Weapon Proficiency
entries: You have proficiency with {@filter Advanced weapons|items|type=advanced weapon}, and your training allows you to use the mastery properties of those weapons.

name: Aereni Expertise
entries: Growing up in Aerenal, you spent decades developing your talent with one particular skill. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Skill Proficiency
entries: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

entries.name: Expertise
entries: You gain {@variantrule Expertise|XPHB} with the skill you selected for this feat.

name: Aereni Half-Life
entries: You've undergone rituals that bind you to Irian and the Undying Court. Many who undergo this process have a desiccated appearance, similar to a mummy; it's up to you to decide whether you are affected in this way. Regardless of your appearance, you gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Deathless
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB|Death Saving Throws}.

entries.name: Resistance
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Necrotic damage and Radiant damage.

entries.name: Radiant Focus
entries: If you cast a spell that deals Necrotic damage, you can choose to have it inflict Radiant damage instead.

name: Aerial Expert
entries: Years of practice or an innate talent have made you adept at gliding. You gain the following benefits:

items: You no longer need to move at least 10 feet to perform long and high jumps. You may choose whether the jump uses your Strength or Dexterity score for determining height or distance, and you double the distance you would normally leap in either case.
You may take the {@action Dash} action while gliding to fly an additional distance up to your movement speed.
You may change direction freely while gliding, and may gain up to 10 feet of altitude once before you finish your descent.

name: Against the Unseen
entries: Elves can perceive creatures that dwell in the wraith-world, be they spirits or ghosts, even when they are normally {@condition invisible} to the eyes of the living and appear only as a chilling whisper of voices. You have learnt to strengthen your heart against such terrors.

items: You have advantage on Charisma saving throws, and you cannot be {@condition frightened} by Undead creatures.

name: Alacrity
entries: You move at supernatural speeds. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Burst of Speed
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend 1 Blood Point to gain an additional action. That action can be used to take only the {@action Attack|XPHB} (one attack only) or {@action Disengage|XPHB} action.

entries.name: Fast
entries: Your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 10 feet, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} rolls.

name: Altered
entries: You have been changed through magic, science, or a volatile blend of the two. You have a blatant physical augmentation of your choice from the options below. The augmentation is obvious—such as with stitches, grafts of other creature's body parts, or implants—unless disguised.

entries.name: Aquatic Adaptation
entries: You have gills or mucus membranes that allow you to breathe water, and you have webbed extremities that grant you a {@variantrule Swim Speed|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.

entries.name: Natural Armor
entries: You have scales, plates, or thick hide that grants you an AC of 13 + your Dexterity or Constitution modifier (choose the ability when you select this feat).

entries.name: Natural Weapons
entries: You have claws, fangs, horns, or some other natural weapon that you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes} that deal {@damage 1d8} damage on a hit. The damage is Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing as appropriate to the form.

entries.name: Night Vision
entries: You have {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet. If you already have {@sense Darkvision|XPHB}, its range increases by 30 feet.

name: Aquatic Adaptation
entries: You are able to live underwater. This may be a natural feature of your character if you're playing a Malenti or an Elf from Valraea, or it could be the result of arcane transmutation or a divine blessing. Whatever the origin of this gift, you gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: You can breathe underwater. If you possess the Limited Amphibiousness trait in addition to this feat, this eliminates your dependence on water.

entries.name: Athletic Build
entries: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Athletics|XPHB} skill.

entries.name: Natural Swimmer
entries: You have a {@variantrule Swim Speed|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.

name: Art of Disappearing
entries: Hobbits are said to have little or no magic about them, but the way they can choose to disappear quickly and quietly can be described by others only as supernatural. You have learnt to choose exactly the right moment to turn away from the attention of others, sometimes unconsciously anticipating the need to disappear.

items: Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check you make.
You can try to hide even when you are only lightly obscured from the creature from which you are hiding.

name: Ashbound Initiate
entries: You have learned a certain number of the secrets and techniques of the Ashbound druidic order. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Ashbound Proficiencies
entries: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Intimidation|XPHB} skill.

entries.name: Arcane Enmity
entries: When a creature you can see casts a spell, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against that creature until the end of your next turn.

entries.name: Ashbound Spells
entries: The secrets you've learned allow you to always have certain spells at the ready. When you have spell slots of a level specified in the Ashbound Spells table, you thereafter have the spells listed for that level and lower prepared.

name: Axe Fighter
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Axe Flurry
entries: Once on each of your turns, if you hit a creature with a {@item Handaxe|XPHB}, you can make an extra attack with a {@item Handaxe|XPHB} as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

entries.name: Precise Topple
entries: When you hit a creature with a {@item Battleaxe|XPHB}, that creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the Constitution saving throw to avoid having the {@condition Prone} condition caused by the {@itemMastery Topple} property of the {@item Battleaxe|XPHB}.

entries.name: Unending Cleave
entries: The number of additional creatures you can attack using the {@itemMastery Cleave} property of a {@item Greataxe|XPHB} increases by a number equal to half your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} (rounded down).

name: Axe Thrower
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Returning Throw
entries: When you make a ranged weapon attack with a {@item Handaxe|XPHB} and miss on your attack roll, you can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on the same turn to catch the weapon as it whirls back to you.

name: Bandit Cunning
entries: Your time as a bandit has granted you a sense for danger, and made you skilled at sizing up opponents. You gain the following benefits:

items: When you are asked to make a saving throw, you may spend your reaction to add your Intelligence modifier as an additional bonus to the saving throw. You cannot use this ability again until you have completed a long rest.

During combat, you can use your action to make an Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check against any creature you have seen fight. As long as you succeed against a DC of 10 + their challenge rating, you can learn one useful fact of your choice about the target's combat abilities. Choose from:
one damage resistance or immunity
one condition immunity
one special ability possessed by the creature that either does damage, or prevents damage
one option under their attack, legendary, or reaction actions
one special sense they possess

activation.condition: When you are asked to make a saving throw

name: Baruk Khazâd!
entries: The {@language Khuzdul|TLotRR|secret tongue of the Dwarves} is guarded as a treasure of the past, yet their battle-cry is well-known and feared by their foes.

items: You can use a bonus action on your turn to force each hostile creature that can hear and see you within 30 feet of you to make a Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) check (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your choice of your Strength or Charisma modifier). On a failed check, the creature becomes {@condition frightened} of you until the end of your next turn. {@action Attack} rolls against creatures {@condition frightened} in this way have advantage. Once you use this virtue, you cannot use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

name: Battle Cry
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Thunderous Cry
entries: You can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to release a frightening battle cry. Roll a Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) check. One creature of your choice that can hear you within 30 feet of you must make a Wisdom saving throw with a DC equal to your Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) check result or have the {@condition Frightened} condition for {@dice 1d4} rounds. The target can make a new saving throw at the end of each of its turns to end the effect. Once you've used this ability, you can't use it again until you've completed a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}.

At higher levels, you can target an additional number of creatures with this ability. At 9th level, you can target two creatures. At 15th level, you can target three creatures, and the range of this ability increases to 60 feet.

name: Beast-Craft
entries: You gain the ability to comprehend and verbally communicate with beasts. The knowledge and awareness of many beasts is limited by their intelligence, but at minimum, beasts can give you information about nearby locations and creatures, including whatever they can perceive or have perceived within the past day. You might be able to persuade a beast to perform a small favour for you, at the Loremaster's discretion, such as delivering a letter, or a verbal message to someone who can also speak with beasts.

In addition, as an action you can spend a craft slot and choose a beast that you can see within 30 feet of you. It must be able to see and hear you. Make a Wisdom ({@skill Animal Handling}) check, contested by the target's Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check. If you win the contest, the beast is {@condition charmed} by you for 24 hours or until you or your companions do anything harmful to it. If you obtain a magical success and the target is a beast with a challenge rating of 1/8 or lower, you can make the beast permanently {@condition charmed} by you, until you dismiss it, harm it, or make another beast permanently charmed by you. A beast automatically wins the contest if its Intelligence score is 4 or higher. When you reach 5th level, you can affect one additional beast, or two additional beasts at 9th level.

name: Blackpowder Pistol Expert
entries: You have become practiced with the use of {@item Blackpowder Pistol|GrimHollowPG24|Blackpowder Pistols}. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Deadeye
entries: Attacking at long range doesn't impose {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on your attack rolls with a {@item Blackpowder Pistol|GrimHollowPG24}.

entries.name: Quick Load
entries: You ignore {@itemProperty LD|XPHB|Loading} of the {@item Blackpowder Pistol|GrimHollowPG24}.

entries.name: Trick Shot
entries: Immediately after a creature within 5 feet of you moves, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to make a ranged attack with a {@item Blackpowder Pistol|GrimHollowPG24} against that creature.

name: Blade Barrier
entries: Your expertise with twinblades allows you to turn your defensive flourish into an offensive strike. When you use the Whirl special bonus action with a twinblade, you gain the following features:

items: You can make one additional melee attack with the weapon. This attack uses the same ability modifier as the primary attack, and the weapon's damage die for this attack is a d4.
Until the start of your next turn, other creatures provoke an opportunity attack from you when they enter your reach or make a melee attack against you while within your reach.

name: Blessing of Angrboda and Bergelmir
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Thunderous Strike
entries: When you hit with a melee weapon attack, you can choose to deal an extra {@damage 1d6} Thunder damage. You can use your Thunderous Strike a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Prophetic Vision
entries: As a {@action Magic} action, you can choose one Divination spell with a casting time of 1 action (from any spell list) of a level you can cast that is no more than half your character level and cast it without expending a spell slot. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability stat. Once you use this feat to cast the spell, you can't use it again until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Blessing of Baldur
entries: You gain the following benefit.

entries.name: Protective Aegis
entries: Once per {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, when you or an ally within 10 feet of you takes damage, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to reduce that damage by an amount equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} + your Charisma modifier (minimum 1).

entries.name: Radiant Aura
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you emit a bright golden light in a 10-foot-radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for another 10 feet. You may extinguish this light with another {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

entries.name: Sunlance
entries: You know the {@spell Sacred Flame|XPHB} cantrip. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

name: Blessing of Boreas
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Cold Aegis
entries: If you take Cold damage, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to give yourself {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Cold damage until the end of your next turn. You can use this {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Winter Magic
entries: You know the {@spell Ray of Frost|XPHB} cantrip. Choose either the {@spell Armor of Agathys|XPHB} or {@spell Ice Knife|XPHB} spell. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast the spell once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast this spell using any spell slots you have. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this feat's spells (choose when you select this feat).

name: Blessing of Bragi
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Love of the Vanir
entries: You gain {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB} with the {@skill Persuasion} skill if you don't already have it, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) checks.

name: Blessing of Eir
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Vitality Points
entries: You have a number of Vitality Points equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} and can spend the points on the benefits below. You regain your expended Vitality Points when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Vitality Surge
entries: You can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} and spend 1 Vitality Point to recover {@dice 1d4} {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. If you are dying, you can spend 1 Vitality Point to {@variantrule Stable|XPHB|stabilize} (no action required).

entries.name: Channel Vitality
entries: You can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} and spend 1 Vitality Point to cause a creature you touch to regain {@dice 1d4} {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

name: Blessing of Freyr and Freyja
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Wild Knowledge
entries: You have proficiency in either the {@skill Animal Handling} or {@skill Nature} skill.

entries.name: Green Magic
entries: You learn the {@spell Druidcraft|XPHB} and {@spell Thorn Whip|XPHB} cantrips. Choose either the {@spell Entangle|XPHB} or {@spell Hail of Thorns|XPHB} spell. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast the spell once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast this spell using any spell slots you have. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this feat's spells (choose when you select this feat).

name: Blessing of Heimdall
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Awareness of the Guardian
entries: You have {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB} in the Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) skill. If you already have {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB}, you gain {@variantrule Expertise|XPHB} in that skill. In addition, when you make a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check, you can decide to give yourself {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}. You can do this a number of times per day equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Herald's Horn
entries: You gain proficiency in the {@item Horn|XPHB}.

entries.name: Vigilance
entries: When you roll {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB}, you can reroll the check but must use the new result. Once you use this feature, you must finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} before you can use it again.

name: Blessing of Hel
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Forestall the End
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB|Death Saving Throws}.

entries.name: Resurgence
entries: If you become {@variantrule Stable|XPHB} following a third successful {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB}, or if you are stabilized by another creature, you immediately recover {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 1d6} plus your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}.

entries.name: The Bell Tolls
entries: You know the {@spell Spare the Dying|XPHB} and {@spell Toll the Dead|XPHB} cantrips. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this feat's spells (choose when you select this feat).

name: Blessing of Jormungandr
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Poison Resilience
entries: If you take Poison damage, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to give yourself {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Poison damage until the end of your next turn. You can use this {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Serpent Kinship
entries: You always have the {@spell Animal Friendship|XPHB} and {@spell Speak with Animals|XPHB} spells prepared. You can cast each spell once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. When you cast these spells without a spell slot, you may only target snakes and serpents. You can also cast these spells using any spell slots you have. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells (choose when you select this feat).

entries.name: Serpent's Tongue
entries: You know the {@language Draconic} language.

name: Blessing of Loki
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Expert Liar
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Deception} skill. If you already have proficiency in it, you gain {@variantrule Expertise|XPHB} in it instead.

entries.name: Trickster Magic
entries: You learn the {@spell Minor Illusion|XPHB} and {@spell Vicious Mockery|XPHB} cantrips. Choose either the {@spell Disguise Self|XPHB} or {@spell Charm Person|XPHB} spell. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast the spell once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast this spell using any spell slots you have. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this feat's spells (choose when you select this feat).

name: Blessing of Njord
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Call Sea Serpent
entries: You can cast {@spell Find Steed|XPHB} without expending a spell slot. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast this spell using any spell slots you have. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat).

entries.name: Njord's Protection
entries: You can breathe water as well as air, and automatically succeed on saves against {@hazard Extreme Cold|XDMG} while submerged in water. You also have a {@variantrule Swim Speed|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.

name: Blessing of Sif
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Gift of Dexterity
entries: When you make a Dexterity check, you can add your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} to the roll. If you already add your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} to a Dexterity check, you may add it an additional time. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} and regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Sif's Prowess
entries: You know the {@spell True Strike|XPHB} cantrip. Choose either the {@spell Hunter's Mark|XPHB} or {@spell Longstrider|XPHB} spell. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast the spell once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast this spell using any spell slots you have. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this feat's spells (choose when you select this feat).

name: Blessing of Skadi
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Hunter's Eye
entries: When you use the {@action Attack|XPHB} action to make a ranged weapon attack, you can choose to give yourself {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the attack roll. Once you use this feature you must finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Snowpace
entries: Your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 10 feet when you move on ice or snow, and you never treat those types of terrain as {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}.

name: Blessing of the Snow Queen
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Frozen Edge
entries: You know the {@spell Ice Knife|XPHB} Spell. You can cast it without using a spell slot a number of times per day equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast this spell using any spell slots you have. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat).

entries.name: Shield of the North Wind
entries: If you fail a saving throw against a spell or effect that deals Cold damage, you can choose to succeed instead. Once you use this feature you must finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} before you can use it again.

name: Blessing of Thor
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Gift of Strength
entries: When you make a Strength check, you can add your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} to the roll. If you already add your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} to a Strength check, you may add it an additional time. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} and regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Storm Magic
entries: You know the {@spell Shocking Grasp|XPHB} or {@spell Thunderclap|XPHB} cantrip (choose when you select this feat). You also always have the {@spell Thunderous Smite|XPHB} spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast this spell using any spell slots you have. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat).

name: Blessing of Tyr
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Bravery
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws made to avoid or end the {@condition Frightened} condition.

entries.name: Justicar
entries: As a {@action Magic} action, you can touch a creature and compel it to tell the truth. The creature must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature can't speak a deliberate lie for 1 minute. You know whether a creature succeeds or fails on this save. An affected creature is aware of the spell and can avoid answering questions to which it would normally respond with a lie. Such a creature can be evasive yet must be truthful.
You can use this feature at will, but when you use it on a creature, you must finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} before you can use it on that creature again.

name: Blessing of Volund
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Crafter's Knack
entries: You gain proficiency with an {@item Artisan's Tools|XPHB|Artisan's Tool} of your choice. If you already have proficiency with that tool, you instead have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on checks with it.

entries.name: Forge Magic
entries: You learn the {@spell Elementalism|XPHB} and {@spell Mending|XPHB} cantrips. Choose either the {@spell Burning Hands|XPHB} or {@spell Shield|XPHB} spell. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast the spell once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast this spell using any spell slots you have. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this feat's spells (choose when you select this feat).

name: Blessing of Wotan
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Lore Bound
entries: You gain proficiency with one of the following skills: {@skill Arcana}, {@skill History}, {@skill Nature}, or {@skill Religion}. If you already have proficiency with the chosen skill, you gain {@variantrule Expertise|XPHB} in it.

entries.name: Secret Wisdom
entries: You know the {@spell Guidance|XPHB} cantrip. Choose a level 1 spell from any school of magic. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast the spell without expending a spell slot. Once you cast the spell in this way, you can't cast that spell in this way again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast the spell using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this feat's spells (choose when you select this feat).

name: Blood Hound
entries: Your senses are heightened beyond those of most folk. Whether these senses were strengthened through training or the loss of other senses, or they simply matured as you did, you are a master of finding those whom you seek. You  gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Motion Sensor
entries: Whenever a creature that is Small or larger moves within 10 feet of you while you do not have the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition, you immediately become aware of its presence.

entries.name: No Hiding
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks that rely on sound or smell.

name: Blood of the Berserker
entries: You inherited a touch of the ferocity of a berserker ancestor. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Berserker Fury
entries: When you are {@status Bloodied|XPHB}, you can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to enter a frenzied state. While in this fury, your melee weapon attacks deal extra damage equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you don't have the {@condition Unconscious} condition when you are reduced to 0 HP (though you still make {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB|Death Saves} as normal).

Your Berserker Fury lasts for 1 minute or until you end it (no action required), or if you have the {@condition Incapacitated} condition. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Bloodied Resilience
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Bloodied Reaction
entries: While you're {@status Bloodied|XPHB} and take any damage, you can spend one of your {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Dice} as a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} and reduce the damage you take by the amount rolled. You can only spend one {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Die} at a time in this way, each time you are damaged.

entries.name: Bloodied Saves
entries: If you succeed on a Strength or Constitution saving throw that would normally cause you to take half damage, you take no damage instead.

name: Bloody Resolve
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Inner Fire
entries: Pain bolsters your resolve. When you take damage, you gain a +1 bonus to saving throws until the end of your next turn. While you are {@status Bloodied|XPHB}, the bonus to saves increases to +2, and you also gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls until the end of your next turn.

name: Boisterous Roar
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Mighty Yell
entries: When you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} against a target, you let out a boisterous roar. You and allies within 5 feet of you have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to all damage until the end of your next turn, and enemies within 5 feet of you have {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} to all damage until the end of your next turn.

name: Boomerang Expert
entries: You have mastered the versatile boomerang and are capable of performing extraordinary feats with the weapon. You gain the following benefits:

items: The damage die for the boomerang is now a {@dice d8} for you.
Attacking at long range doesn't impose disadvantage on ranged attack rolls made with a boomerang.
You automatically catch the boomerang after throwing it without needing to use your reaction.

name: Boon of Generations
entries: You have become the embodiment of the ancient vampires of your bloodline. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Deep Feeding
entries: Whenever you roll a Feed Die for your {@classFeature Feed|Kindred|BoundByBlood|1} feature, you can reroll the die if it rolls a 1, and you must use the new roll.

entries.name: Potent Blood
entries: Your Blood Point maximum increases by 5.

name: Boon of Magic Resistance
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Heroic Resistance
entries: If you fail a saving throw, you can cause yourself to succeed instead. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Boon of Perfect Flight
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Flying
entries: You have a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} of 40 feet and can hover.

entries.name: Graceful Fall
entries: If you fall more than 5 feet, your rate of descent slows to 60 feet per round until you land.

name: Boon of Shadowsteel Mastery
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Strange Bedfellows
entries: You are no longer affected by the {@optfeature Friendless|GrimHollowPG24|Friendless Transformation Flaw}.

name: Boon of the Archlich
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Vessel of Vitality
entries: Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, if your {@optfeature Soul Vessel|GrimHollowPG24} is not charged, it gains a soul and becomes charged.

name: Boon of the Ascended Vampire
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Inured to Sunlight
entries: You are no longer affected by sunlight.

name: Boon of the Earthly Tether
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Persistent Haunter
entries: You are no longer affected by the {@optfeature Fraying Reality|GrimHollowPG24|Fraying Reality Transformation Flaw}.

entries.name: Divergent Growth
entries: Choose any {@filter Specter Transformation Boon|optionalfeatures|source=grimhollowpg24|feature type=spec:tb|miscellaneous=} that you don't already have but meet the prerequisites for. You gain that Boon.

name: Boon of the Elder Fey
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Fey Bulwark
entries: You are no longer affected by the {@optfeature Weakened Constitution|GrimHollowPG24|Weakened Constitution Transformation Flaw}.

entries.name: Divergent Growth
entries: Choose any {@filter Fey Transformation Boon|optionalfeatures|source=grimhollowpg24|feature type=f:tb|miscellaneous=} that you don't already have but meet the prerequisites for. You gain that Boon.

entries.name: Free Agent
entries: You are no longer affected by the {@optfeature Pull of the Netherworld|GrimHollowPG24|Pull of the Netherworld Transformation Flaw}.

entries.name: Divergent Growth
entries: Choose any {@filter Fiend Transformation Boon|optionalfeatures|source=grimhollowpg24|feature type=fi:tb|miscellaneous=} that you don't already have but meet the prerequisites for. You gain that Boon.

name: Boon of the Elder Horror
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Stabilizing Form
entries: When you roll a 25 or lower on the {@table Unstable Form|GrimHollowPG24|Unstable Form table}, you can choose to roll again. You must use the new result. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Divergent Growth
entries: Choose any {@filter Aberrant Horror Transformation Boon|optionalfeatures|source=grimhollowpg24|feature type=ah:tb|miscellaneous=} that you don't already have but meet the prerequisites for. You gain that Boon.

name: Boon of the Elemental Temperance
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Controlled Chaos
entries: You are no longer affected by the {@optfeature Primordial Chaos|GrimHollowPG24|Primordial Chaos Transformation Flaw}.

name: Boon of the High Seraph
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Absolution
entries: You are no longer affected by the {@optfeature Seraph Corruption|GrimHollowPG24|Seraph Corruption Transformation Flaw}.

entries.name: Divergent Growth
entries: Choose any {@filter Seraph Transformation Boon|optionalfeatures|source=grimhollowpg24|feature type=ser:tb|miscellaneous=} that you don't already have but meet the prerequisites for. You gain that Boon.

name: Boon of the Wilds
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Apex Predator
entries: When you enter your Hybrid Form, you gain 25 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}. At the end of each of your turns while in Hybrid Form, if you have no {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}, you gain 10 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}. While you are in your Hybrid Form and have no {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls.

name: Brave at a Pinch
entries: One of the Wise once said that you have to put a Hobbit in a tight place before you find out what is in them. You prefer to avoid finding yourself in one, but you are also sure you would be able to take good care of yourself in the circumstances.

items: Whenever a hostile creature or harmful effect imposes a condition on you, you suffer one or more levels of {@condition exhaustion}, or you drop to half or less of your maximum hit points, you gain inspiration.

name: Brazen Courage
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Staunch Will
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against the {@condition Frightened} condition. Also, you can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to end the {@condition Frightened} condition on yourself a number of times per day equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Bree-Pony
entries: Bree-ponies are very similar to their owners, the Bree-folk—they don't seem to have anything special compared to their peers in other parts of Middle-earth, and yet some of them display uncommon courage and exceptional memory. You have acquired an unusually brave and intelligent beast that follows you everywhere.

items: Your pony uses your proficiency bonus rather than its own, and adds your proficiency bonus to each of its ability scores, AC, and to any ability check or saving throw that it makes.
Your pony has a number of Hit Dice equal to your character level instead of its normal Hit Dice (minimum 2).

Your pony obeys your commands. In combat, it takes its turn on your initiative and acts and moves as you direct it (no action required by you), or on its own if you are absent or {@condition incapacitated}. It cannot make {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks}, and its only action options are {@action Dash}, {@action Disengage}, and {@action Dodge}, unless you spend an action on your turn to command it to take another action. If your pony dies, you can acquire a new one during the next Yule Fellowship Phase.

name: Brewer
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Tool Proficiency
entries: You gain proficiency in {@item brewer's supplies|XPHB}.

entries.name: Discount
entries: You get a 50% discount when purchasing food and beverages.

entries.name: Quick Brewing
entries: When you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can brew an invigorating mead, provided you have {@item Brewer's Supplies|XPHB} available. A creature can use a {@action Utilize|XPHB} action to drink the mead, granting it {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}. The mead's potency lasts until you start a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Broken Spells
entries: In ancient times, the Dwarves made mighty spells. You have been taught fragments of old enchantments that retain some power to this day.

items: Choose any combination of three skills or tools you are proficient with. Whenever you make an ability check that uses one of the chosen proficiencies, you can obtain a magical success. You can do so a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

name: Brutal Grip
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Heavy Duelist
entries: You can wield a Melee weapon with {@itemProperty 2H|XPHB|Two-Handed} in one hand.

entries.name: Versatile Dual Wielder
entries: While wielding a Melee weapon with {@itemProperty V|XPHB|Versatile} in one hand, the weapon has the {@itemProperty L|XPHB|Light} property for you.

entries.name: Brutal Weaponry
entries: You can wield a weapon that has the {@itemProperty 2H|XPHB|Two-Handed} property in one hand, provided your other hand isn't also wielding a weapon that has the {@itemProperty 2H|XPHB|Two-Handed} property or holding a {@item Shield|XPHB}.

entries.name: Killing Streak
entries: When you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action on your turn and attack with a weapon that has the {@itemProperty 2H|XPHB|Two-Handed} property, you can make one extra attack as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} later on the same turn. That extra attack must be made with a {@itemProperty L|XPHB|Light} weapon, and you don't add your ability modifier to the extra attack's damage unless that modifier is negative or you have the {@feat Two-Weapon Fighting|XPHB} feat.

name: Bumbling Fool
entries: You have a peculiar way of fumbling through life that somehow always works out in your favor, succeeding in situations through what others might view as accidental luck. When you fail an ability check and roll a number on the die equal to half your level (rounded up) or lower, you can choose to replace the die roll with a 15 instead. You can use this ability three times, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

name: Canden and Moon's Master Cut

prerequisite.other: You must have beaten a master at Master Canden and Moon's Sword School

entries: Having trained with the masters of the first sword school of Obojima, you've picked up a handful of useful skills. You gain the following benefits:

items: Your walking speed increases by 5 feet.

Immediately after rolling initiative, you can use your reaction before the first turn of combat to draw a weapon and move up to half your speed (rounded up). If you end this movement within reach of another creature, you can use the weapon to make one melee attack against that creature.

When you are hit by an attack, you can use a reaction to assume a defensive stance, allowing you to fend off incoming strikes. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack. Once you assume this stance, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

name: Cannoneer
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Cannon Proficiency
entries: You gain proficiency with {@item Cannon|SGEHPP|Cannons}, and you can reload a {@item Cannon|SGEHPP} as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} instead of an action. You can take this {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} only if you haven't moved during your turn, and after you take the {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is 0 until the end of your turn. Starting at character level 11, this doesn't reduce your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}, and when you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action, you can replace one of your attacks with reloading the {@item Cannon|SGEHPP}. When you reach character level 20, you can ignore the {@itemProperty SGEHPP:Art|SGEHPP|Artillery} property of {@item Cannon|SGEHPP|Cannons}.

entries.name: Siege
entries: Your attacks with {@item Cannon|SGEHPP|Cannons} deal double damage to objects and structures.

entries.name: Strong Back
entries: The weight of {@item Cannon|SGEHPP|Cannons} and {@item Cannonball|SGEHPP|Cannonballs} count as half for you.

name: Careful Crafter

otherSummary.entry: Proficiency in a skill or tool

entries: You've trained in crafting items using a skill or tool that you're proficient with, and your creations are known for being well made and reliable. You gain the following benefits:

items: You make all ability checks for crafting with advantage.
Anyone assisting you in crafting an item gains advantage on their ability checks for crafting.
If you fail to successfully craft the item, the amount of time it took to complete the process is halved.

name: Cat's Caress
entries: Manipulating your bladed digits with preternatural delicacy, you can switch from exsanguinating slash to soft caress with a deft flick.

items: After you take the Attack action using a {@item claw|HelianasGuidetoMonsterHunting} in one hand, you can use a bonus action to make up to two melee attacks with a different claw that you're holding in the other hand. You don't add your ability modifier to the damage of the bonus attack(s), unless that modifier is negative, or you have the two-weapon Fighting Style.
You have advantage to hit a target you are grappling with an attack using a {@item claw|HelianasGuidetoMonsterHunting}.
You can equip or unequip either a single or a pair of claws using either a bonus action or action.

name: Changeling Metamorphosis
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Hardened Skin
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB}.

entries.name: Metamorphosis
entries: When you use your Shape-Shifter trait, you may choose one of the following options. You gain the benefits of the chosen option until you use your Shape-Shifter trait again.

entries.name: Aquatic Adaptation
entries: You sprout gills and grow webs between your fingers. You can breathe underwater and gain a {@variantrule Swim Speed|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You have {@spell Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet.

entries.name: Natural Weapons
entries: You grow claws (Slashing), fangs (Piercing), horns (Piercing), or hooves (Bludgeoning). When you use your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} to deal damage with that new growth, it deals {@damage 1d6} damage of the type in parentheses instead of dealing the normal damage for your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, and you can choose to use your Dexterity modifier for the attack and damage rolls rather than using Strength.

name: Charm Twister
entries: You know hedge remedies and hexes passed down through Old Ways teachings, and you can impart them into small wicker charms you weave. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Old Blessing
entries: You can cast the {@spell Bless|XPHB} spell once using this benefit, targeting only creatures carrying a wicker charm you've woven, and you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have. Your spellcasting ability for casting the spell in this way is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (choose the ability when you select this feat).

entries.name: Twisted Hex
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can weave spite into a wicker charm you touch. Choose an ability. When another creature is carrying the charm, or while this charm is within an area that the creature considers home, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on ability checks and attack rolls using the chosen ability. When the creature fails one of these rolls, it can make a Charisma saving throw, destroying the charm on a success (DC = 8 plus your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} and the ability modifier you chose for Old Blessing). You can only have one Twisted Hex charm at a time. If you make a new one, the previous one loses its magic.

name: Chosen by Fate
entries: The Norns have chosen you for greater things. As a result, you gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Heroic Resurgence
entries: If you use {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB} and the die roll fails, your use of {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB} isn't expended (though you can't use it again for the same {@variantrule d20 Test|XPHB}).

entries.name: Heroic Windfall
entries: Whenever you use {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB}, you regain a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the die roll. If you are already at your {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point maximum} when you use {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB}, you instead gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the die roll. If you use {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB}, and you roll higher on the die than is necessary to restore you to your {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point maximum}, you gain any excess as {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

name: Cloak of Shadows
entries: You are adept at supernaturally masking your presence. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Enshrouded
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you give yourself {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on your next Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) check on the current turn.

entries.name: Unseen Passage
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you gain the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition until the end of your next turn.

You can use this {@action Magic|XPHB} action a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Close Combat Artillerist
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Firing in Melee
entries: Being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn't impose {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on your attack rolls with Ranged weapons.

entries.name: Point Blank
entries: When you hit a creature that is within 5 feet of you with a ranged attack, you gain a +2 bonus to the damage roll.

name: Cloud Hopper
entries: Your exposure to the great wind spirit has changed you. You gain the following benefits:

items: When you move on your turn, you can choose to conjure tiny clouds below your feet, allowing you to move into unoccupied spaces in the air. You can move a number of feet in this way equal to 5 × your proficiency bonus before the clouds stop appearing. Ending this movement while in the air causes you to fall as normal.

You learn the {@spell Fog Cloud} and {@spell Gust of Wind} spells, each of which you can cast once without expending a spell slot. You regain the ability to cast these two spells in this way when you finish a long rest. You can also cast the spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Your spellcasting ability for this spell is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (your choice).

name: Clout
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Strong Influence
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma ({@skill Deception}, {@skill Intimidation}, and {@skill Persuasion}) checks when interacting with Vikings, professional warriors, and other martial folk. When using the {@feat Inspiring Leader|XPHB} feat, you also add your Strength modifier to the {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} you grant.

name: Cold Plunge Training
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Cold Water Training
entries: While in water, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against {@hazard Extreme Cold|XDMG} and on Strength ({@skill Athletics}) checks to swim.

entries.name: Arctic Dive
entries: On a turn when you dive from land into water, your movement in the water is at your normal {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} rather than half {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.

name: Cold Water Warrior
entries: You have become accustomed to spending time in cold, treacherous waters. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Against the Current
entries: You automatically succeed on Strength checks to move through rough water.

entries.name: Cold Water Resistance
entries: You have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the effects of immersion in frigid water for a number of hours equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}.

entries.name: Swimming Leap
entries: You can make {@variantrule Long Jump|XPHB} and {@variantrule High Jump|XPHB} while swimming. If you swim at least 10 feet before a jump, you are considered to have a running start.

entries.name: Water Combatant
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} if you begin combat at least partially submerged in a body of water.

name: Combat Flyting
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Taunt
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on your turn, you can demean and bait an opponent within 30 feet of you that can hear and understand you. The target must succeed on a Charisma Saving Throw (DC 8 plus your Charisma modifier plus your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}). On a failed save, the target takes a -1 penalty to attack rolls against you. You can use another {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on each of your subsequent turns to impart another -1 penalty; these effects stack to a maximum equal to your Charisma modifier. The target is allowed a save against each of these uses.

This effect ends if you drop to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, have the {@condition Incapacitated} condition, you fail to use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} each round to maintain it, or if the target moves more than 30 feet away from you. Otherwise, it continues for a maximum number of rounds equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}.
A creature that succeeds on the saving throw has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to your Taunts for 24 hours.

name: Confidence
entries: Overcoming difficulties has reinforced your spirit and renewed your faith in a brighter future.

items: You gain proficiency in saving throws using Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (your choice).

name: Convincing Inquisitor
entries: You know how to spot a liar, and you can get people to see your way, whether through charm, reasonable arguments, or force of will. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Charming Presence
entries: When you take the {@action Influence|XPHB} action, you don't have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on checks to influence {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} creatures, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on checks to influence {@variantrule Indifferent [Attitude]|XPHB|Indifferent} creatures.

entries.name: Multiple Paths
entries: You can use any ability modifier when you take the {@action Influence|XPHB} action to make an {@skill Intimidation|XPHB} or  {@skill Persuasion|XPHB} check.

entries.name: Zealous Insight
entries: When you succeed on a {@action Search|XPHB} action's Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) check to detect lies or evasive answers, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} rolls involving combat against that creature for 1 hour.

name: Convincing Thoughts
entries: Your supernatural powers of persuasion are uncannily hidden from your victim's mind. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Charming Smile
entries: You can cast the {@spell Charm Person|XPHB} spell without expending a spell slot a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Rationalize
entries: When spells or effects that cause the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition end, the target doesn't know it was {@condition Charmed|XPHB} by you.

name: Coven Witch

prerequisite.other: You must be a member of a witches coven

entries: You have become an official member of a witches coven.
You gain the following benefits:

items: You learn two random common and uncommon potion recipes from your coven.

You learn two 1st-level spells of your choice. The 1st-level spells must be from the divination, conjuration, or transmutation school of magic. You can cast each of these spells once without expending a spell slot. You regain the ability to cast these two spells in this way when you finish a long rest. You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spells' spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.

name: Craft
entries: You gain a craft slot and a craft of your choice from the Scholar's Crafts list (see {@book Crafts|TLotRR|2|Crafts}).

name: Crimson Ritualist
entries: Your study of blood magic and life force has borne fruit, granting you the following benefits.

entries.name: Blood Lash
entries: You learn the {@spell Blood Bolt|CrookedMoon24} cantrip. Your spellcasting ability for it is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (choose the ability when you select this feat).

entries.name: Bottled Life
entries: When you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can perform a 1-minute ritual to transfer some of your life essence into a vessel for later use. Expend a number of {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} up to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and bleed into a vial of water or other liquid. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, a creature can drink the vial to roll the {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Dice} you expended. The creature regains a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the total rolled plus its Constitution modifier. The vial remains potent until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Cruel
entries: The challenges and struggles you've faced throughout your life have led you to delight in inflicting pain and anguish upon others. You gain a number of cruelty dice equal to your proficiency bonus. Your cruelty dice are {@dice d6|d6s}. You can roll only one cruelty die per turn, and a cruelty die is spent when you roll it.
You can roll a cruelty die under any of the following circumstances, with the indicated result:

items: When you deal damage to a creature, spend one cruelty die to deal extra damage to the creature equal to the roll.
When you score a critical hit, spend one cruelty die to gain temporary hit points equal to the roll.
When you make a Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) check, spend one cruelty die and add the roll to your check.

entries: You regain all spent cruelty dice when you finish a {@quickref resting|PHB|2|0|long rest}.

name: Cult Initiate
entries: Your cult instructs you in eldritch rites, granting you the following benefits.

entries.name: Two Cantrips
entries: You learn two cantrips of your choice from the Warlock spell list. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this feat's spells (choose the ability when you select this feat).

entries.name: Level 1 Spell
entries: Choose a level 1 spell from the Warlock spell list. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have.

entries.name: Spell Change
entries: Whenever you gain a new level, you can replace one of the spells you chose for this feat with a different spell of the same level from the Warlock spell list.

name: Cut Down the Nithingr
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Coward's Bane
entries: You have a +2 bonus to damage rolls you make against creatures with the {@condition Frightened} condition.

entries.name: Frightful Visage
entries: When you use a spell or effect that causes the {@condition Frightened} condition, the duration is doubled.

name: Dark for Dark Business
entries: Your kind is not troubled by mere darkness in itself, as most members of other cultures are. On the contrary, you have grown to like the dark better than the light, finding yourself at ease in its cold embrace.

items: Dim light doesn't impose disadvantage on your Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks relying on sight.

When you are in dim light, in darkness, or underground, and you make an ability check, attack roll, or saving throw, you can do so with advantage. You can use this virtue a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

name: Daywalker
entries: The sun's light doesn't harm you as badly as it does other Kindred. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Dhampir's Boon
entries: When you take damage from sunlight, reduce the damage taken by 2.

entries.name: Endure Radiance
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend 1 Blood Point to remove your {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} to Radiant damage for 1 minute.

entries.name: Wake with Evening's Freshness
entries: When you start a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. If you succeed, you count as having at least 1 Blood Point for that {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Deadly Archery
entries: Elves possess a natural talent for hitting the mark when using their bows. You have honed this talent almost to perfection, and your arrows find their target with uncanny precision.

items: As a bonus action, you can give yourself advantage on your next ranged weapon attack roll on the current turn. You can use this bonus action only if you haven't moved during this turn, and after you use the bonus action, your speed is 0 until the end of the current turn.

name: Death Defier
entries: When the hand of death reaches for your soul, you have found a way to reject its call. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Cling to Life
entries: You add your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1) to {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB|Death Saving Throws}.

entries.name: Enduring Vitality
entries: If an effect would kill you outright without {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB|Death Saving Throws} or would reduce you directly to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} without dealing damage, you are instead reduced to a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your level. You can't use this benefit again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Deathbound
entries: You have seen death many times, up close and personal, and sometimes at your own hand. These experiences have affected you deeply, teaching you about life and death. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: One Last Breath
entries: If you have two {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB} failures, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB|Death Saving Throws} until you are no longer at 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

entries.name: Recuperation
entries: When you spend a {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die} during a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB} to recover {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, you can roll the {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die} twice and use the higher roll.

name: Defiance
entries: Many realms have risen and fallen in the Lone-lands of Eriador since the Elder Days. Only ruins remain to mark their boundaries. Yet, the Bree-men have endured, revealing an unexpected reserve of strength and vigour in the face of adversity.

items: As a bonus action, you can spend one Hit Die to heal yourself.

name: Desperate Courage
entries: You have lived all your life on the edge of the Wild, but the worst news that has come to Bree in your time concerned only brigands or packs of hungry wolves. You don't know yet what the likes of you can do against the Shadow in the East, but you are sure you will stand against it, no matter the cost.

items: Whenever you gain Shadow points, you also gain inspiration.

name: Discipline Acquisition (Animalism)
entries: You learn the basic concepts of a vampiric Discipline from another clan or bloodline. You gain the following benefits.
You gain proficiency in the {@skill Animal Handling|XPHB} and {@skill Nature|XPHB} skills. If you already have proficiency in that skill, you gain {@variantrule Expertise|XPHB} in it.

name: Discipline Acquisition (Auspex)
entries: You learn the basic concepts of a vampiric Discipline from another clan or bloodline. You gain the following benefits.
You gain proficiency in the {@skill Investigation|XPHB} and {@skill Perception|XPHB} skills. If you already have proficiency in that skill, you gain {@variantrule Expertise|XPHB} in it.

name: Discipline Acquisition (Celerity)
entries: You learn the basic concepts of a vampiric Discipline from another clan or bloodline. You gain the following benefits.
You gain an extra {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}, which you can use with any of your existing {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB|Reactions}.

name: Discipline Acquisition (Dominate)
entries: You learn the basic concepts of a vampiric Discipline from another clan or bloodline. You gain the following benefits.
You gain proficiency in the {@skill Deception|XPHB} and {@skill Intimidation|XPHB} skills. If you already have proficiency in that skill, you gain {@variantrule Expertise|XPHB} in it.

name: Discipline Acquisition (Fortitude)
entries: You learn the basic concepts of a vampiric Discipline from another clan or bloodline. You gain the following benefits.
{@variantrule Damage|XPHB} dealt to you except Fire and Radiant is reduced by an amount equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}.

name: Discipline Acquisition (Obfuscate)
entries: You learn the basic concepts of a vampiric Discipline from another clan or bloodline. You gain the following benefits.
You gain proficiency in the {@skill Sleight of Hand|XPHB} and {@skill Stealth|XPHB} skills. If you already have proficiency in that skill, you gain {@variantrule Expertise|XPHB} in it.

name: Discipline Acquisition (Oblivion)
entries: You learn the basic concepts of a vampiric Discipline from another clan or bloodline. You gain the following benefits.
You can see normally in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} and {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}—both magical and nonmagical—within 90 feet of yourself.

name: Discipline Acquisition (Potence)
entries: You learn the basic concepts of a vampiric Discipline from another clan or bloodline. You gain the following benefits.

When you hit a creature with a Melee weapon or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} as part of the {@action Attack|XPHB} action on your turn, you can deal extra damage to the target equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}.

name: Discipline Acquisition (Presence)
entries: You learn the basic concepts of a vampiric Discipline from another clan or bloodline. You gain the following benefits.
You gain proficiency in the {@skill Performance|XPHB} and {@skill Persuasion|XPHB} skills. If you already have proficiency in that skill, you gain {@variantrule Expertise|XPHB} in it.

name: Discipline Acquisition (Protean)
entries: You learn the basic concepts of a vampiric Discipline from another clan or bloodline. You gain the following benefits.
You can deal an extra {@damage 1d6} Slashing damage to a target you hit with an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}.

name: Dour-Handed
entries: Your blows have become more forceful and your aim steadier, allowing you to do greater harm.

items: You gain a +1 bonus to weapon damage rolls using Strength.

name: Dragon-Slayer
entries: The legend of Bard the Bowman has inspired many young men and women from Dale, so much that they long to prove their worth with the killing of a great monster. As many more before you, you have long pondered on the ways to deal with creatures of size, hoping one day to gain renown defeating them.

items: You have advantage on attack rolls against Large or larger creatures.

name: Dread Speech
entries: You have articulated a few words of forbidden truth that resonate with—and fray—the fabric of creation, granting you the following benefits.

entries.name: Eldritch Word
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can speak a magical word aloud to force a creature within 60 feet of yourself to make a Wisdom saving throw (DC = 8 plus your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} and Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma modifier; choose the ability when you select this feat). On a failed save, the target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the start of your next turn. You can use this benefit safely once, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can use it again before resting, but you take {@damage 1d6} Necrotic damage, which can't be reduced or prevented in any way.

entries.name: Shred Fate
entries: Your dread secrets can unravel the destiny of your foes. You always have the {@spell Bane|XPHB} spell prepared, and your spellcasting ability for it is the ability you chose for Eldritch Word. You can cast it once without Material components or a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have.

name: Dual Shot
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Dual Shot
entries: When you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action on your turn and attack with a bow or crossbow, you can make one extra attack as part of the same action against a creature that is within 10 feet of the original target that is within the weapon's range. If you do so, both attacks are made with {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

name: Durin's Way
entries: The Dwarves have fought many wars in deep places beneath the earth. You have been taught how to best defend yourself while fighting underground. As a result, you know how to exploit corners, darkness and other natural obstacles to your advantage.

items: When you have half or three-quarters cover, you gain an additional +1 bonus to AC and Dexterity saving throws.
Other creatures do not gain advantage on attack rolls against you as a result of being unseen by you.

name: Dwarf-Friend
entries: The days of the Dragon have forged a strong alliance between the Bardings and the Dwarves of Erebor.

items: Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check you make. In addition, you have advantage on Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) checks made when interacting with Dwarves.
Increase the Fellowship rating of your Company by 1.

When you are within 5 feet of a friendly Dwarf and at least one of you isn't {@condition incapacitated}, and a creature you or the Dwarf can see attacks you or the Dwarf, you can spend a Fellowship point to impose disadvantage on the attack roll.

name: Elbereth Gilthoniel!
entries: The name of Elbereth, the Queen of the Stars, is revered by all the Eldar still dwelling in Middle-earth. You have resorted to calling on her name in moments of great need, asking the Kindler to bestow her grace upon you.

items: When you are not {@condition miserable|TLotRR} and make an ability check, attack roll, or saving throw, you can do so with advantage. You can use this virtue a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

name: Elvish Spirit
entries: The spirit of Elves is so strong that their bodies recover swiftly from many ills and injuries. You can recover from your exertions while awake, finding repose in the secret way of your folk.

items: If you meditate for at least 4 hours, you can reduce your {@condition exhaustion} level by 1 and regain all lost hit points. You cannot use this virtue if you've had a long rest within the last 24 hours, or if you have 0 hit points. Once you use this virtue, you cannot use it again until you finish a long rest.

name: Endurance Conditioning
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Quick Recovery
entries: Once per day, you can recover from 1 level of {@condition Exhaustion} after completing a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}. In addition, a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} removes 2 levels of {@condition Exhaustion} (instead of 1).

name: Endurance of the Ranger
entries: They say that a Ranger with a clear trail to follow can never be weary. You hope the saying will prove true, as it will be your fate to often travel in haste, to seek distant lands on urgent errands or to relentlessly hunt your enemies.

items: You have advantage on Constitution saving throws.

name: Envoy Specialist
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Envoy Competence
entries: You gain proficiency with one tool of your choice.

entries.name: Integrated Tool
entries: Choose one tool you are proficient with. You have a working model of this tool integrated into your body, which can't be removed. As long as you have a hand free, you can make use of the integrated tool.

entries.name: Innate Talent
entries: When you make an ability check with the integrated tool, you can roll {@dice 1d4} and add the number rolled to the ability check.

name: Expanded Grip
entries: Your natural ability with larger weapons lets you use them in a way others can't. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: One-Handed Grip
entries: When you use a {@itemProperty V|XPHB|Versatile} weapon with one hand, the weapon deals the damage in parentheses when used to make a melee attack.

entries.name: Zealous Grasp
entries: If an effect forces you to drop what you are holding, you can make a DC 15 Strength saving throw to maintain your grip. When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a saving throw to maintain your grip, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the saving throw.

name: Expert Enchanter
entries: You manipulate magical essence with a quick and subtle touch.

items: When you make an Enchanting check with a skill with which you are proficient, your proficiency bonus is doubled.
When you roll for enchanting quirks, you can apply a bonus or penalty to the result of the roll equal to half your proficiency bonus.
Each hour you spend enchanting an item counts as 2 hours towards the item's completion.

name: Expert Forger
entries: An expert with your chosen tools, you can subtly alter an item's final form.

items: When you make a Manufacturing check with a tool with which you are proficient, your proficiency bonus is doubled.
When you forge an item and roll for enchanting and/or manufacturing quirks, you can apply a bonus or penalty to the result of the roll equal to half your proficiency bonus.
Each hour you spend forging an item counts as 2 hours towards the item's completion.

name: Expert Harvester
entries: You have a knack for retrieving exceptional components from the gnarliest of corpses.

items: When you make a Harvesting check using a skill with which you are proficient, your proficiency bonus is doubled.
When you attempt to harvest a creature for which you don't have the required skill proficiency, you can add your proficiency bonus to the result of the roll.
If you are helping with a Harvesting check, you add your full proficiency bonus to the check's result, regardless of whether you're proficient in the requisite skill.
You do not suffer disadvantage on your Harvesting checks as a result of choosing to perform both the Assessment and Carving checks alone.

name: Faithful
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Divine Clarity
entries: If you fail a saving throw against the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} or {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition, you can choose to succeed instead. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Trial of Faith
entries: Whenever you roll a 1 on a {@variantrule d20 Test|XPHB}, you gain {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB}.

name: Familiar Keeper
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Find Familiar
entries: You always have the {@spell Find Familiar|XPHB} spell prepared. Additionally, you can cast it as a {@action Magic|XPHB} action without expending a spell slot or Material components. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat). Once you cast the spell using this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Expanded Options
entries: When you cast {@spell Find Familiar|XPHB}, you can choose one of the normal forms for your familiar or one of the following special forms: {@creature Imp|XMM}, {@creature Pseudodragon|XMM}, {@creature Quasit|XMM}, {@creature Sphinx of Wonder|XMM}, or {@creature Sprite|XMM}.

entries.name: Familiar Distraction
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of your familiar makes an attack roll, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to command your familiar to give the attack {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}. You impose {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} in this way a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Faster Crafting
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Increased Artisan Proficiency
entries: You may either gain proficiency with an {@item Artisan's Tools|XPHB|Artisan's Tool} of your choice or {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on ability checks with a single {@item Artisan's Tools|XPHB|Artisan's Tool} with which you are already proficient.

entries.name: Combat Quickcraft
entries: While in combat, you can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to craft one piece of gear from the Fast Crafting table, provided you have the {@item Artisan's Tools|XPHB} associated with that item, have proficiency with those tools, and do not have the {@condition Incapacitated} condition. The item lasts until the end of your next turn, or until you craft an additional item, at which point it falls apart.

entries.name: Short Rest Crafting
entries: You can craft an item from the Fast Crafting table during a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}. It lasts until the end of the day, you use this aspect of the feat again, or your next {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, whichever comes first, at which point it falls apart.

name: Fate Gambler
entries: Coming out ahead, whether in games of chance or in life-or-death contention, fills you with resolve and vigor. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Bet Big
entries: If you don't already have it, you gain {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB} whenever you succeed on an ability check made against another creature, when you reduce a creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, or when a creature fails a saving throw you forced it to make. If, in any of these cases, the creature has a CR of 0 or lacks a CR (such as another player character), you don't gain {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB}.

entries.name: Win Big
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend your {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB} to gain a number of {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your level.

name: Fearsome Flourisher
entries: Your deadly speed with nunchaku can strike fear into your foes.

items: When you take the Attack action and attack with a {@item nunchaku|HelianasGuidetoMonsterHunting}, you can use a bonus action to make one additional melee attack with the weapon. This attack uses the same ability modifier as the primary attack and the weapon's damage die for this attack is a d4.

When you take the Flourish special action with a {@item nunchaku|HelianasGuidetoMonsterHunting}, you can use a bonus action to make it especially intimidating towards one creature within your reach. If you don't fail on your Dexterity check to flourish the weapon, your target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} of you until the start of your next turn. The DC for the saving throw equals 8 + your Dexterity modifier. If you are proficient in the Intimidation skill, you can add your proficiency bonus to the DC.

name: Feral Whispers
entries: You have an animalistic connection to the creatures of the wilderness. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Call of the Wild
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can expend 1 Blood Point to summon a number of Large or smaller Beasts (such as a {@creature Rat|XMM} or {@creature Wolf|XMM}) equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1).
