The total {@variantrule Challenge Rating|XPHB} for summoned Beasts can't exceed your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}. A summoned Beast arrives at your location in {@dice 1d4 + 1} rounds and is {@condition Charmed|XPHB} by you for 1 minute after it arrives. In combat, a Beast shares your {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don't issue any, it takes the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action and uses its movement to avoid danger.

entries.name: Shared Spirit
entries: You can cast the {@spell Speak with Animals|XPHB} spell, but only as a {@variantrule Ritual|XPHB}.

name: Fey Pact
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Fey Bond
entries: You know Sylvan. If you already know Sylvan when you select this feat, you instead learn one language of your choice from the language tables in the Player's Handbook. You also gain {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB} in the {@skill Nature|XPHB} skill.

entries.name: Fey Cantrips
entries: You know the {@spell Druidcraft|XPHB} cantrip and learn one other cantrip of your choice from the Divination or Enchantment school of magic. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells (choose when you select this feat).

entries.name: Honeyed Words
entries: When you fail a Charisma ({@skill Deception|XPHB} or {@skill Persuasion|XPHB}) check, you can reroll the check, and you must use the new roll. Once this benefit turns a failure into a success, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Fey Sentinel
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Fading Target
entries: When an enemy misses you with an attack roll, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to gain the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition until the start of your next turn or until immediately after you make an attack roll, deal damage, or cast a spell. Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Fey Shift
entries: When you take the {@action Dash|XPHB} action, you can forgo the extra movement to teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within a distance equal to half your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} instead.

entries.name: Nature's Roots
entries: You always have the {@spell Entangle|XPHB} spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast it using any spell slots you have. The spell's spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.
When you reach character level 5, you also always have the {@spell Plant Growth|XPHB} spell prepared and can cast it the same way.

name: Fey Tormentor
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Faerie Time Warp
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, choose up to three creatures you can see within 60 feet of yourself. Each target makes a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 plus the ability modifier of the score increased by this feat and your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}). On a failed save, the target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is reduced by 10 feet, and it takes a -2 penalty to AC until the end of your next turn.
Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Hag's Hex
entries: You always have the {@spell Hex|XPHB} spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast it using any spell slots you have. The spell's spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.
When you reach character level 5, you also have the {@spell Bestow Curse|XPHB} spell prepared and can cast it in the same way.

name: Field Commander
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Command
entries: As an action, you can issue a command to an ally within 60 feet that can hear you. It can immediately take an action as a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}. That action can be used to take only the {@action Attack|XPHB} (one attack only), {@action Dash|XPHB}, {@action Dodge|XPHB}, {@action Hide|XPHB}, {@action Influence|XPHB}, {@action Search|XPHB}, {@action Study|XPHB}, or {@action Utilize|XPHB} action.

entries.name: Tight Formation
entries: While you are within 5 feet of two or more allies that don't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition, enemies can't have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against you.

name: Field Cook
entries: Able to whip up a tasty meal from the barest ingredients, your meals fuel the resolve of the most stalwart adventurers.

items: You gain proficiency with cook's utensils.
You can replace one type of ingredient in a recipe with any other ingredient type.
Before rolling for quirks, you can choose to replace one roll on the boon table with inspiration, granting inspiration to each creature that consumes at least one portion of your meal.
After rolling for quirks, you can remove one flaw of your choice, or add a boon to the dish by rolling on the boons table (your choice).

name: Field Medic
entries: You have been specially trained in magical triage and are able to identify the signs of shock and fatigue in those suffering from injuries. You are always ready to provide aid to those in need. You gain the following benefits:

items: You can tell by looking at a creature if it is missing any of its hit points and whether or not it has more than half of its hit points. You also have advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) or Intelligence ({@skill Arcana} or {@skill Religion}) checks made to determine if the creature is cursed, diseased, possessed, or afflicted by any of the following conditions: {@condition blinded}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition exhaustion}, {@condition incapacitated}, {@condition paralyzed}, or {@condition poisoned}.
You learn the {@spell spare the dying} cantrip and can cast it as a bonus action.

You gain the ability to cast the spell {@spell cure wounds} without using a spell slot, up to a number of times equal to half your proficiency bonus. You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

name: Fierce Shot
entries: The Black Arrow that brought down Smaug the Dragon may have been fated to do so, but the hand that sent it flying so fiercely was exceedingly strong. When you throw a spear or bend your bow, you make sure that your grip is steady and your aim true.

items: When making an attack with a ranged weapon, you use your choice of your Strength or Dexterity modifier for the attack and damage rolls. You must use the same modifier for both rolls.

If you move no more than half your speed on the same turn and you hit a creature with a ranged weapon attack, you can use a bonus action to cause the attack to deal {@damage 1d4} extra damage of the weapon's type.

name: Fighting Style
entries: You can choose a fighting style option from the Champion's {@classFeature Fighting Style|Champion|TLotRR|1|TLotRR} feature. As normal, you cannot take a Fighting Style option more than once.

name: Fisher
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Survivalist
entries: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Survival} skill.

entries.name: Boat Familiarity
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule d20 Test|XPHB|d20 Tests} made to operate water vehicles.

entries.name: Fishing Prowess
entries: When you are exploring and have access to a body of water, you can spend 1 hour to fish and obtain enough food for up to 6 people for 1 day.

name: Fjord Jumper
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Cliff Leaping
entries: Your jumping distance (whether {@variantrule High Jump|XPHB|High} or {@variantrule Long Jump|XPHB|Long}) increases by 10 feet. You also have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on any attack roll, Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check, or Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check you make after jumping at least 10 feet high or 20 feet long.

entries.name: Safe Diving
entries: If you fall into a liquid, such as water, and you spend your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} and succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) or Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check, you take no damage from the fall. You also have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on that check.

name: Flamewoken
entries: Living in the Scorched Grove or other areas touched by elemental fire can sometimes cause strange abilities to manifest among their inhabitants. Known as "flamewoken" by the Tenders, these gifted few have the ability to communicate with fire-aspected creatures and have power over flames. Tenders guide the flamewoken in honing their talents in service of nature and many flamewoken choose to join the order. However, those outside the order usually keep their abilities hidden, as such powers are often seen as a curse. You gain the following benefits:

items: You can speak, read, and write {@language Primordial||Ignan}.
You learn the {@spell produce flame} cantrip. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

As a bonus action, you can strengthen the power of your flames. The next time you deal fire damage to one or more creatures before the end of your next turn, you can deal an additional {@damage 2d10} fire damage to one of those creatures. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you complete a short or long rest.

You can whisper magical words in {@language Primordial||Ignan} toward any nonmagical flames you can see within 30 feet of you that could fit within a 5-foot cube. As a bonus action, you can cause these flames to either grow by 5 feet in a single direction, provided there is fuel of some sort present in the new location, or you can extinguish the flames present in this space.

name: Flash Recall
entries: You've developed the ability to instantly recall an unprepared spell in moments of sudden necessity.

As a bonus action, you prepare a spell of 1st level or higher from your spellbook (if you're a {@class wizard}) or from your class spell list (if you're not a {@class wizard}). This spell must be of a level for which you have spell slots, and it replaces another spell of an equal or higher level that you had previously prepared.
Once you use this feat to recall a spell, you can't do so again until you complete a {@quickref resting|PHB|2|0|short or long rest}.

entries.name: Rules Tip: Prepared Spells
entries: The Flash Recall feat requires you to be a spellcaster who prepares spells. This includes classes such as {@class cleric||clerics}, {@class druid||druids}, and {@class paladin||paladins}, who prepare spells each day from their class list, and {@class wizard||wizards}, who prepare spells from a spellbook. Classes such as {@class bard||bards} and {@class sorcerer||sorcerers}, who inherently know their spells rather than preparing them, can't benefit from this feat.

name: Flex Caster
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Upcast
entries: When you cast a spell, such as {@spell Magic Missile|XPHB}, that can be cast with a higher-level spell slot for more powerful effects, you can expend any additional spell slot to increase the spell's effective level by 1, to a maximum of level 9.

entries.name: Downcast
entries: When you cast a spell using a higher-level spell slot, you choose to recycle the excess magical energy instead of improving the spell. The spell is cast at its base level and you regain an expended level 1 spell slot.

name: Flurry
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Quick Strike
entries: Once on each of your turns when you make an attack roll with a weapon or an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} and have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the roll, you can forgo {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on that attack roll. After resolving that attack, you can then make another attack with the same weapon or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} against a different creature. The new target must be within 5 feet of the first target and within the weapon's reach.

name: Focused Critical
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Improved Critical
entries: Your attack rolls with weapons and {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes} can score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} on a roll of 19 or 20 on the {@dice d20}.

name: Focused Personas
entries: You've developed personas that help you focus your talents. Work with your DM to define two unique personas—identities with distinct appearances and personalities. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Adept Persona
entries: Choose a tool and define a persona associated with it. Whenever you use your Shape-Shifter trait to assume the persona, you gain proficiency with the chosen tool and when you make an ability check with the chosen tool, you can roll {@dice 1d4} and add the number rolled to the ability check.

entries.name: Expert Persona
entries: Choose a skill you are proficient in and define a different persona associated with it. Whenever you use your Shape-Shifter trait to assume the persona, you gain {@variantrule Expertise|XPHB} in the chosen skill.

entries.name: Skin Cant
entries: You are fluent in {@language Skin Cant|ExploringEberron24}, a language used by the Changeling Travelers.

name: Forager
entries: You've spent countless hours exploring the island searching for ingredients. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Survival} skill. If you already have this proficiency, you instead gain expertise with that skill, which means your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make using it.
You produce twice the number of common or uncommon ingredients when foraging.

name: Forceful Presence
entries: You can focus your vampiric presence to instill emotions in others. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Awe
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you give yourself {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma ({@skill Intimidation|XPHB}, {@skill Performance|XPHB}, and {@skill Persuasion|XPHB}) checks for 10 minutes.
You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Daunt
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, make a Charisma ({@skill Intimidation|XPHB}) check and choose a creature you can see within 30 feet of you. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw with a DC equal to the result of your {@skill Intimidation|XPHB} check. On a failed save, the creature has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. At the end of each of the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} creature's turns, the creature repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature with an Intelligence of 3 or lower automatically succeeds on its saving throw against this effect.
You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} and regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Foresight of their Kindred
entries: The Rangers of the North still possess a measure of the foresight that their ancestors possessed in full. In the Twilight of the Third Age, this gift manifests as a sense of watchfulness, and of fear, arising to warn a Ranger of a danger that has not yet come to pass.

items: You have a number of foresight points equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1). Whenever you or a creature that you can see make an ability check, attack roll, or saving throw, you can spend one foresight point to reroll the {@dice d20} and must use the new roll. You can choose to spend one of your foresight points after the roll, but before the outcome is determined. You can also spend one foresight point after a roll on the Journey Events table. Roll a {@dice d20}, and then choose whether the Loremaster uses their roll or yours. You regain your expended foresight points when you finish a long rest.

name: Forest Sage
entries: The Tenders value diversity among ideas, and although they began as a purely druidic order, they have since learned to accept many different ways of thinking about the natural world, especially regarding the application of magic. You are either a {@class wizard} who has learned to temper your arcane research with an eye to maintaining the delicate balance of natural forces, or you are a {@class druid} who has learned a new understanding of natural magic through study and experimentation. You gain the following benefits:

items: You can use your choice of Intelligence or Wisdom to make {@skill Animal Handling}, {@skill Arcana}, {@skill Nature}, or {@skill Survival} checks.

You can choose to learn two spells from either the druid or wizard spell list. Spells you choose must be of a level you can cast. The chosen spells count as spells of your class and are added to your spellbook if you are a {@class wizard} or your spells known if you are a {@class druid}.

name: Forgemaster
entries: Your deftness with your tools of choice is unparalleled.

items: When you make a Manufacturing check with a tool with which you are proficient, you have advantage on the roll.
You gain proficiency with 2 tools of your choice.
Each hour you spend forging an item counts as 3 hours towards the item's completion.

name: Fortune of the Thaumaturge
entries: Your connection to the Thaumaturge puts you in touch with forces outside mortal understanding, making others think you were born under a fortunate moon. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Fortune's Fortitude
entries: When you fail a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}, you can expend and roll one {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die}, adding that number to your result. You can do this only once per {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}.
You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all uses of this ability when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Fortune of the Unknown
entries: When using the Fortune's Fortitude benefit, if you roll the highest or lowest number on the {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die}, you regain that {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die}. It still counts as a use of Fortune's Fortitude.

name: Free Sword Mercenary's Will
entries: Your training with the Company of Free Swords has given you an increased stamina and an attitude that make you less likely to succumb to hardships. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Hold the Ground
entries: When you are moved without using your movement by a creature, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to reduce the distance you are moved by up to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.

entries.name: Resolute
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws that would apply a condition.

name: Freediver
entries: You have undergone extensive underwater training. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain a swimming speed equal to twice your Constitution score (rounded up to the nearest 5 feet). If you already have a swimming speed, it instead increases by 10 feet.
You triple your Constitution modifier when calculating how long you can hold your breath.
You gain resistance to cold damage.

name: Friendly and Familiar
entries: Since you started your adventures, you have realised that your folk's custom of trading with foreigners may help you in your endeavours. Your nice manners and friendly demeanour easily gain the sympathies of those you meet, and your ability to inquire about the doings of strangers without letting curiosity get the better of you provides you with many opportunities to learn from those you meet along the way.

items: Increase the Fellowship rating of your Company by 1.

Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check you make. In addition, you have advantage on the first Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check you make when interacting with Dwarves, Elves, Hobbits, and Men (other than the Dúnedain).

name: Frost Eyed
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Bright Eyed
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks in {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB}, and you do not have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB}.

entries.name: Ice Tracker
entries: You are proficient in the {@skill Survival} skill. You treat both snow and icy terrain as normal terrain. You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on {@skill Survival} checks made in snow or ice.

name: Frost-Touched
entries: Your connection to the ancient frozen power of the Northlands grants you the following benefits.

entries.name: Frost Magic
entries: You know your choice of the {@spell Frostbite|XPHB} or {@spell Ray of Frost|XPHB} cantrip. Choose one level 1 spell that deals Cold damage from the Druid, Sorcerer, or Wizard spell lists. You always have that spell and the {@spell Gust of Wind|XPHB} spell prepared. You can cast each of these spells without expending a spell slot. Once you cast either spell in this manner, you can't cast that spell again until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spells' spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.

name: Gatekeeper Initiate
entries: You have learned a certain number of secrets and techniques of the Gatekeeper druidic order. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Gatekeeper Proficiency
entries: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Arcana|XPHB} skill.

entries.name: Protection Against Aberrations
entries: When you make a saving throw against the magic abilities of an Aberration or a spell cast by an Aberration, you can roll {@dice 1d4} and add it to your saving throw.

entries.name: Gatekeeper Spells
entries: The secrets you've learned allow you to always have certain spells at the ready. When you have spell slots of a level specified in the Gatekeeper Spells table, you thereafter have the spells listed for that level and lower prepared.

name: Ghostlight Medium
entries: You formed a mystical connection to the Ghostlight Express that affords you insight into the nature of spirits, granting the following benefits.

entries.name: Ghostly Touch
entries: When you damage a creature with the Incorporeal Movement trait, you can ignore the creature's damage {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB|Resistances}, if any.

entries.name: Spirit Sense
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can sense any Undead within 60 feet of you, or any creatures in the Ethereal Plane that overlaps that area. You learn the distance and direction to any creatures you detect (or an Ethereal creature's equivalent position on your plane). Once you detect a creature with this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Giant Slayer
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Duck and Weave
entries: If you are within 5 feet of a Large or larger creature, you can take the {@action Dodge} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

entries.name: The Bigger They Are
entries: You're adept at knocking Large or larger creatures off their feet. When you use the {@itemMastery Topple} Weapon Mastery feature against a creature of Large or larger size, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on its save.

name: Gleam of Wrath
entries: Your folk have seen many defeats, and many fruitless victories in their wars against the Shadow. The deadly rage that your kindred harbour for the Enemy infuses your weapons with a gleam of chill flame.

items: As a bonus action, you can make a melee weapon that you are wielding emit dim light in a radius equal to its reach until the start of your next turn. The light is sunlight. While the weapon gleams, it also deals radiant damage instead of its normal type.
When you score a critical hit with a weapon attack, you can roll one of the weapon's damage dice one additional time and add it as extra radiant damage.

name: Glima
entries: Glima is the name for a style of unarmed fighting in the North similar to wrestling. When you hit with an unarmed attack against a creature within 5 feet of you, if that creature is one size larger than you or smaller, you can choose to force that creature to make a Strength saving throw (DC equals 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} + your Strength modifier). On a failed save, the target creature has the {@condition Prone} condition.

name: Grave Keeper
entries: Studying funeral rites and tending the dead's rest has made you a conduit between the worlds of the living and the dead. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Divine Channel
entries: You gain one use of the Channel Divinity feature from the Cleric class, and you can create the Turn Undead effect with it. If you already have Channel Divinity, you add this use to the feature from one class of your choice. Your save DC for this benefit is 8 plus your Wisdom modifier and {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}.

entries.name: Last Rites
entries: You can enact a 10-minute ritual to prepare the corpse of a Medium or smaller creature, expending at least 10 GP worth of incense, oils, linen wraps, or similar trappings. The prepared corpse can't become Undead.

name: Greater Blessing of Baldur
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Divine Resilience
entries: When you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to one damage type of your choice. This {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} lasts until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Greater Blessing of Boreas
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Cold-Forged
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Cold damage. Additionally, you can summon a shield of cold to block fire-based effects. As a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}, when you would take Fire damage, you can gain {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Fire damage until the beginning of your next turn.

name: Greater Blessing of Freyr and Freyja
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Healing Magic
entries: You always have the {@spell Cure Wounds|XPHB} spell prepared. You can cast it without using a spell slot a number of times per day equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast it using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spell's spellcasting ability is the ability you chose when you took the Blessing of Freyr and Freyja feat. When you cast the spell on a Beast or Plant creature, the amount healed is doubled.

name: Greater Blessing of Jormungandr
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Serpent's Aspect
entries: You can channel the fear inspired by serpents and dragons. You can use an {@variantrule Action|XPHB} to force a number of creatures of your choice equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} within 30 feet of you that can see you to make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 plus your Charisma modifier and your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}). On a failed save, a target has the {@condition Frightened} condition for 1 minute. Such a creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Greater Blessing of Loki
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Lord of Lies
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma ({@skill Deception}) checks.

entries.name: Mask Magic
entries: You always have the {@spell Alter Self|XPHB} spell prepared. You can cast it without expending a spell slot. Once you cast the spell in this way, you can't cast it in this way again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast it using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spell's spellcasting ability is the one you chose when you took the Blessing of Loki feat.

name: Greater Blessing of Sif
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Sif's Arrow
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can channel the power of the god Sif for 1 minute. During that time, when you hit with a ranged weapon attack, you deal extra damage of the weapon's type equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}. You can deal this extra damage no more than once on each of your turns. You can channel Sif's power in this way a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Greater Blessing of Thor
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Storm Strike
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can channel the power of the god Thor for 1 minute. During that time, when you hit with a melee weapon attack, you deal extra damage of the weapon's type equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}. You can deal this extra damage no more than once on each of your turns. You can channel Thor's power in this way a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Greater Blessing of Wotan
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Lore Master
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} when rolling checks for the skill you selected for your Lore Bound trait from the Blessing of Wotan feat.

entries.name: Magical Foresight
entries: You always have the {@spell Augury|XPHB} spell prepared. You can cast it without expending a spell slot. Once you cast the spell in this way, you can't cast it in this way again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast this spell using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spell's spellcasting ability is the ability you chose when you took the Blessing of Wotan feat.

name: Greater Discipline Acquisition (Animalism)
entries: Your talents with the vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline have improved. You gain the following benefits.

You can cast the {@spell Speak with Animals|XPHB} and {@spell Animal Messenger|XPHB} spells but only as Rituals. You can cast the {@spell Animal Friendship|XPHB} spell without expending a spell slot a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Greater Discipline Acquisition (Auspex)
entries: Your talents with the vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline have improved. You gain the following benefits.
As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend 1 Blood Point to gain {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Intelligence and Wisdom checks and saving throws for 1 minute.

name: Greater Discipline Acquisition (Celerity)
entries: Your talents with the vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline have improved. You gain the following benefits.

As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} or as a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} when you are hit by an attack roll, you can expend 1 Blood Point to double your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} and gain a +3 bonus to AC until the start of your next turn.

name: Greater Discipline Acquisition (Dominate)
entries: Your talents with the vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline have improved. You gain the following benefits.

You can cast the {@spell Charm Person|XPHB} and {@spell Suggestion|XPHB} spells. You can cast either spell without expending a spell slot a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Greater Discipline Acquisition (Fortitude)
entries: Your talents with the vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline have improved. You gain the following benefits.

When you're subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Constitution saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw and only half damage if you fail. You can't use this feat if you have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition. In addition, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Constitution saving throws.

name: Greater Discipline Acquisition (Obfuscate)
entries: Your talents with the vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline have improved. You gain the following benefits.
While entirely in {@spell Darkness|XPHB}, you have the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition to any creature that relies on {@spell Darkvision|XPHB} to see you in that {@spell Darkness|XPHB}.

name: Greater Discipline Acquisition (Oblivion)
entries: Your talents with the vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline have improved. You gain the following benefits.
You can expend 1 Blood Point to cast the {@spell Darkness|XPHB} spell. When you cast the spell in this way, you can modify it so that it doesn't require {@status Concentration|XPHB}.

name: Greater Discipline Acquisition (Potence)
entries: Your talents with the vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline have improved. You gain the following benefits.

As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend 2 Blood Points to empower your strikes for 1 minute. When you hit a target with an attack roll using a Melee weapon or an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, the target takes an extra {@damage 1d10} Force damage. In addition, you deal double damage to objects and structures.

name: Greater Discipline Acquisition (Presence)
entries: Your talents with the vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline have improved. You gain the following benefits.

You expend 3 Blood Points to cast the {@spell Fear|XPHB} spell. When you cast the spell in this way, you can modify it so that it doesn't require {@status Concentration|XPHB}, and creatures have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the saving throw against the spell.

name: Greater Discipline Acquisition (Protean)
entries: Your talents with the vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline have improved. You gain the following benefits.
As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend 2 Blood Points to deal an extra {@damage 2d6} Slashing damage to a target you hit with an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} for 1 minute.

name: Greensinger Initiate
entries: You have learned a certain number of secrets and techniques of the Greensinger druidic order. You gain the following benefits:

entries.name: Greensinger's Proficiency
entries: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Performance|XPHB} skill.

entries.name: Fey Dancer
entries: Whenever you cause a creature to gain the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition, you can join them in dance and revelry. If you do so, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to move up to half your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}.

entries.name: Fey Affinity
entries: Your spells and magical abilities that affect Humanoids also affect Fey.

entries.name: Greensinger Spells
entries: The secrets you've learned allow you to always have certain spells at the ready. When you have spell slots of a level specified in the Greensinger Spells table, you thereafter have the spells listed for that level and lower prepared.

name: Grizzled
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Overcome
entries: Whenever you make a saving throw against the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition, you gain a bonus to the saving throw equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}.

entries.name: Survive
entries: You require half as much food and water to survive, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Survival|XPHB}) checks made to forage for food and water.

entries.name: Withstand
entries: Immediately after you take damage that causes you to be {@status Bloodied|XPHB}, you gain {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB}. You can't gain this benefit again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Group Combatant
entries: You've honed your fighting skills and are just as comfortable fighting a group of enemies as you are facing a combatant one on one. You gain the following benefits:

items: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage that you take from nonmagical attacks is reduced by 2, to a minimum of 1.
Creatures don't gain advantage on attacks made against you using the optional flanking rules.
After you provoke an opportunity attack on your turn, your movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks for the rest of the turn.

name: Gun-Mage Adept
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Ranged Weapon Proficiency
entries: You gain proficiency with Ranged Martial weapons.

entries.name: Cantrip
entries: You learn the {@spell Finger Guns|ValdaGunslinger} cantrip.

entries.name: Expanded Spell List
entries: The following spells are added to your spell list: {@spell Antiballistics Field|ValdaGunslinger}, {@spell Ballistic Smite|ValdaGunslinger}, {@spell Conjure Cannonball|ValdaGunslinger}, {@spell Conjure Cover|ValdaGunslinger}, {@spell Jam Weapon|ValdaGunslinger}, {@spell Jethro's Instant Reload|ValdaGunslinger}, and {@spell Perforating Shot|ValdaGunslinger}.

entries.name: Spells Prepared
entries: Choose a number of spells equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} from among those in the Expanded Spell List benefit. You always have these spells prepared. Whenever you gain a new level, you can replace one of these spells with a different spell from the Expanded Spell List.

name: Hand-Craft
entries: This craft is not meant to cover the whole range of abilities of smiths, wrights, and other artisans, but reflects a talent for making things with superior skill and cunning. During a Fellowship Phase, you can spend a craft slot and choose a non-magical item in your possession. You must be proficient with the tools related to the item you choose, and you might also need access to special materials or locations, such as a forge. If a feature lets you add double your proficiency bonus with a tool, you can select two item related to that tool instead of one. Then, choose one of the following options for each item:

items: If it's a suit of armour or a shield, it is upgraded with a reward (see {@book Chapter 4|TLotRR|3|Rewards List}). When you reach 5th level, a creature also gains a +1 bonus to Armour Class while wearing or holding it.

If it's a weapon, it is upgraded with a reward. If you can obtain a magical success with the tools used, the weapon can also become magical. When you reach 5th level, a creature also gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it.

If it's any other item, choose a skill somehow related to the item, for example {@skill Stealth} if the item is a cloak, or {@skill Athletics} if the item is a pair of boots. A creature holding or wearing the item gains a Blessing die (see {@book Chapter 7|TLotRR|6|Marvellous Artefacts and Wondrous Items}) on ability checks using that skill. If you can obtain a magical success with the tools used, the item can instead become a Marvellous Artefact with a blessing affecting the chosen skill (see {@book Chapter 7|TLotRR|6|Marvellous Artefacts and Wondrous Items}).

entries: Each of the above options can only be chosen once for each item, and you cannot regain a craft slot expended in this way until the next Fellowship Phase, when you can withdraw the bonuses granted by that slot and regain the slot, if you wish.

name: Hardened Skin
entries: Your skin is dense and difficult to damage. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Damage Resistance
entries: Select Bludgeoning or Slashing damage. You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to the chosen damage.

name: Hardiness
entries: Your determination and stamina have improved through hardship and toil.

items: Your hit point maximum increases by an amount equal to your level when you gain this virtue. Whenever you gain a level thereafter, your hit point maximum increases by an additional hit point.

name: Healthy
entries: You have, for whatever reason, maintained a physically healthy lifestyle. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Hit Die Use
entries: The first time you would spend a {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die} after completing a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you gain the benefit of spending the Hit Die but do not spend it.

entries.name: Saving Throw Proficiency
entries: Choose one ability in which you lack saving throw proficiency. You gain saving throw proficiency with the chosen ability.

name: Heavy Glider
entries: You were either born with great strength, or trained hard to allow yourself to glide under circumstances most would find impossible. You gain the following benefits:

items: You may glide while holding a heavy weapon and wearing heavy armor as long as you aren't encumbered.

You may choose to land your glide in a space occupied by a hostile creature that is Large or smaller. If you do so, you may roll an opposed Strength check against the creature. On a success, you push them 10 feet away and knock them {@condition prone} with the force of your impact. On a failure you land in the nearest un-occupied space.

name: Heightened Senses
entries: Your vampiric senses are stronger and more precise than ever before. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Preternatural Perception
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB} and {@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks.

entries.name: Sense the Unseen
entries: You have {@sense Blindsight|XPHB} with a range of 30 feet. In addition, you can cast the {@spell See Invisibility|XPHB} spell without expending a spell slot a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Heir of Arnor
entries: The days of your folk have darkened, and not many of you remain; but ever the memory of the Kings is passed from generation to generation. An artefact going back to the days of Lost Arnor has been in your family's possession for unbroken generations. Now you have been deemed worthy to become its keeper.

items: With the help of the Loremaster, use the {@book rules in Chapter 7|TLotRR|6|Marvellous Artefacts and Wondrous Items} from {@i The Lord of the Rings Roleplaying} to create either a Wondrous Item, or a Famous Weapon possessing a single enchanted reward. The item is generally of Númenórean craftsmanship, but might even be of Elven or Dwarven make. If it is a Famous Weapon, it can be upgraded with up to two non-enchanted rewards, as if it was a normal item.

name: Heroic Rush
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Triumphant Boost
entries: When you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB}, your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 10 feet and you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls. These benefits last until the end of your next turn.

entries.name: Victorious Inspiration
entries: When you reduce a creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} with an attack, you can choose one ally within 30 feet of you to receive {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB}. The ally must use this {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB} before the end of their next turn or it is wasted. You can use this feature twice, regaining all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Hewn for Battle
entries: You have reshaped your stone body to be a more effective and devastating weapon of war. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Thickened Hide
entries: When you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can choose the thickness of your natural armor. While you aren't wearing armor, your base {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} becomes your choice of either 14 plus your Dexterity modifier, or 18. You can use a Shield and still gain this benefit.

entries.name: Spellcarving
entries: Your hide can be enchanted or infused as if it were nonmagical armor.

entries.name: Claws
entries: You have shaped your hands into fearsome claws. Your claws are natural weapons, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes}. If you hit with them, you deal Slashing damage equal to {@dice 1d6} plus your Strength modifier in place of the normal Bludgeoning damage of your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}.

name: High Destiny
entries: Stories tell that those who belong to the race of Dale are destined for greatness, a fact proven true by your King and his story. Do you share the same destiny of those of the line of Girion?

items: You have advantage on death saving throws.
Whenever you become stable, you also regain 1 hit point.

name: Hit Die
entries: You gain a Hit Die, a {@dice d6}, and your hit points maximum increases by {@dice 1d6} (or 4) + your Constitution modifier.

entries.name: Special
entries: You may take this feature multiple times.

name: Holmganga Master
entries: Your experience in dueling gives you the following benefits.

entries.name: Battle Primed
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} at the start of a Holmganga or other duel.

entries.name: Duel Intimidation
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can make a Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) check against your holmganga opponent. If the check succeeds (GM's discretion), you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on your next attack against the target, and the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on its next attack against you.

name: Hulking Figure
entries: Either from extensive training or a natural build, you have a broad and formidable size for your species. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Brutal
entries: Once per turn, you can deal an extra {@damage 1d4} Bludgeoning damage to a target you hit with an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}.

entries.name: Intimidating
entries: When you make a Charisma ({@skill Intimidation|XPHB}, {@skill Performance|XPHB}, or {@skill Persuasion|XPHB}) check, you can also add your Strength modifier to the roll.

entries.name: Powerful
entries: You count as one size larger (to a maximum size of Large) when determining your carrying capacity.

name: Hunter
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Improved Tracking
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) and Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) checks to follow or identify tracks.

entries.name: Greater Stealth
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} when on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks while outdoors.

name: Hunter of Hunters
entries: You are adept at hunting monstrous prey, granting you the following benefits.

entries.name: Dead Aim
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can scrutinize a creature to spot its vulnerable points. The next time you deal damage to the creature before the start of your next turn, you ignore the creature's damage {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB|Resistances}, if any.

entries.name: Studied Quarry
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on ability checks made to recall information about a creature.

name: I Fought, I Lived
entries: You confronted a horror from beyond this world or spawned by terrible magic. It disregarded you as a puny mortal, but it learned its mistake the hard way when you sent it back to wherever it came from with good, old-fashioned muscle, courage, and a really, really large axe.
You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Defiant Strike
entries: While you are {@status Bloodied|XPHB} and hit with a spell or weapon attack, you can choose to treat the attack's damage roll as having rolled the maximum damage possible. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Indomitable Heart
entries: If you have the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition at the start of your turn, roll a {@dice d20}. On a 10 or higher, you no longer have that condition.

name: I Hid from the Terror
entries: That night is a blur. A strange presence, an overwhelming terror, and a confused jumble of screams mixed with faint memories of something terrible and hungry. You hid from it, finding a place too small for it to reach. The sounds of that night, and the awful aftermath you found that morning, will remain with you to the end of your days and beyond.
You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Shadowed Strike
entries: If attacking would end the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition on you, you can make an attack and keep that condition. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}. You regain expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Beneath Notice
entries: When you attempt to hide from a creature that is larger than you, you can hide if you are lightly obscured or more than 30 feet away from it. You gain the benefits of being hidden against such creatures, but you do not hide from other creatures.

entries.name: Merge into Shadows
entries: Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks made to detect you while you have the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

name: I Opened the Gate
entries: You didn't mean for things to turn out this way. You were curious and perhaps ignored a few signs, but it's hard to take ancient curses seriously. Musty old books say a lot of things, and most of them turn out to be mere fables. Most of them. The one book you read turned out to be the key to unleashing some ancient evil. Now it's in the world, and it's up to you to find it and send it back.
You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Delver into Forgotten Lore
entries: You learn three languages of your choice.

entries.name: Foul Arcana
entries: You can tap into a brief glimpse of the mythos to empower a spell, at the cost of overwhelming your mind with a horrifying, cosmic insight. When you cast a spell, you can give that spell's save DC a +2 bonus but you have the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition until the start of your next turn. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}. You regain expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: I Pierced the Illusion
entries: You came across something strange and awful, made all the more terrible by its hidden nature. A town might have seemed innocent until it dragged unwitting visitors to their carefully tended sacrificial garden, or the family that took you in on a dark, stormy night were actually hungry cannibals. You survived because you saw their disguise and escaped or struck first.
You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Clear Senses
entries: If you have the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition at the start of your turn, roll a {@dice d20}. On a 10 or higher, you no longer have that condition.

entries.name: Ear for Falsehood
entries: When an NPC speaks to you, you can use this ability to determine if they are lying. You learn nothing about the truth they conceal or why they are lying, simply that there is a knowing falsehood in their statement. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}. You regain expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Subtle Interrogation
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Insight checks made against creatures that you are speaking with.

name: I Survived to Tell the Tale
entries: You encountered something dreadful, a horrible creature or bizarre ritual that set you down the path to becoming an investigator of the strange. Your quick feet and instinct for survival carried you through that day and are your best assets.
You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Instinct to Survive
entries: When you take damage that would reduce you to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, you can immediately regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your level. When you use this benefit, you cannot use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Superior Speed
entries: You gain a +10 bonus to {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.

entries.name: Wriggle Free
entries: If you would gain the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition, roll a {@dice d20}. On a 10 or higher, you instead do not gain it.

name: Ice Mastery
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Fimbulwinter's Grasp
entries: Your cold spells carry the strength of Fimbulwinter. Whenever you deal Cold damage to a creature with a spell of at least 1st level, you can choose one of the following additional effects.

items: The creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Dexterity checks for 1 minute as a terrible cold numbs its body.

The creature is coated in ice. It has the {@condition Restrained} condition until it succeeds on a Dexterity saving throw to free itself (equal to your spell saving throw DC) or takes at least 10 points of Bludgeoning or Fire damage. It can make the save to end this effect at the end of each of its turns.

The creature has {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} to Cold damage for 1 minute. It can make a Constitution saving throw (equal to your spell saving throw DC) to end this effect at the end of each of its turns.

entries: You can use Fimbulwinter's Grasp a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Infernal Bulwark
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Devil's Flesh
entries: Your skin thickens and assumes a scaled, leathery texture. While you aren't wearing armor or wielding a {@item Shield|XPHB}, your base {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} equals 10 plus your Dexterity modifier plus the modifier of the ability increased by this feat.

entries.name: Infernal Protection
entries: You always have the {@spell Armor of Agathys|XPHB} spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. When you cast it without a spell slot using this feature, you cast this spell as its level 2 version, and it deals Fire damage instead of Cold damage. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

entries.name: Vengeful Surge
entries: Whenever a creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself forces you to make a saving throw and you succeed, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to deal {@damage 1d10} Fire damage to that creature.
You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Infernal Dragoon
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Devilish Aura
entries: Your close association with diabolic powers unsettles others. You can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to manifest an aura of fear in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from yourself. Each creature of your choice in that area makes a Charisma saving throw (DC 8 plus the modifier of the ability increased by this feat plus your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}). On a failed save, it has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature is unaffected, and it is immune to this ability for 24 hours.

entries.name: Devil's Favor
entries: You can call on your infernal patron to aid you. When you make a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}, you can add a +2 bonus to the roll. Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Diabolic Empowerment
entries: You always have the {@spell Magic Weapon|XPHB} spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. When you cast it without a spell slot using this feature, the spell's duration becomes 8 hours for that casting. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

name: Infernal Pact
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Infernal Resistance
entries: You gain {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Fire damage or Poison damage (choose when you select this feat).

entries.name: Infernal Sight
entries: You gain {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 30 feet. This {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} is unimpeded by magical {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}.

entries.name: Silver-Tongued
entries: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Deception|XPHB} skill.

name: Insightful Collector
entries: Your expeditions, transactions, and mercantile activities on behalf of the Augustine Trading Company have put you in contact with collectors of historical artifacts, relics, and tomes. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Object Intuition
entries: You can take a {@action Study|XPHB} action to examine one magical object and learn its properties and how to use it without attuning to it or taking a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB} in physical contact with it, but you don't learn any curse the item might bear. There is a cumulative 5% chance for every rarity above Common that you misidentify the nature and the power of the object.

entries.name: Rare Find
entries: You begin play in possession of a Common magic item. Work with your GM to decide on which object fits your character and the campaign.

name: Iron Gut
entries: You can eat like a hill giant and drink like a fish. Years of punishing your stomach and liver have led to a powerful fortitude. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Inured to Poison
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws you make to avoid or end the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition.

entries.name: Everything Looks Delicious
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Survival|XPHB}) checks to forage for food.

entries.name: Quick to Recover
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend one of your {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB}, roll the die and add your Constitution modifier, and regain a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the roll's total. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Iron Hero
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Underdog's Resolve
entries: When you are attacked by a creature that has a CR higher than your character level, you gain a +2 bonus to your {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} for that attack.

entries.name: Vengeful Strike
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against any creature that has reduced one of your allies to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} since the end of your last turn.

entries.name: Heroic Intervention
entries: When an enemy you can see takes a Legendary Action, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to intercede, preventing the Legendary Action from happening. You can take this {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} and regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Iron Hero
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Underdog's Resolve
entries: When you are attacked by a creature that has a CR higher than your level, you gain a +2 bonus to your {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} for that attack.

entries.name: Vengeful Strike
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against any creature that has reduced one of your allies to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} since the end of your last turn.

entries.name: Heroic Intervention
entries: When an enemy you can see takes a Legendary Action, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to intercede, preventing the Legendary Action from happening. You can take this {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} and regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Jack of All Tools
entries: You learn to wield tools with precision and efficiency, improvising where necessary.

items: You gain proficiency with 3 tools of your choice.

When you make a Manufacturing check using a tool with which you are not proficient, you can add half your proficiency bonus instead, and do not suffer any disadvantage due to not having proficiency with the tool.
Each hour you spend manufacturing an item counts as 2 hours towards the item's completion.

name: Juggernaut Plating
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Resilient Armor
entries: While you remain alive, armor you have donned can't be targeted by any effect (such as the {@spell Heat Metal|XPHB} spell or the antennae of a rust monster) against your will.

entries.name: Adamantine Body
entries: Any {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} against you becomes a normal hit.

name: Khesh'dar Training
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Swift and Silent
entries: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Stealth|XPHB} skill.

entries.name: Master of Shadows
entries: You gain {@variantrule Expertise|XPHB} with the {@skill Stealth|XPHB} skill.

entries.name: Fade Away
entries: When you take the {@action Hide|XPHB} action, the DC for a successful check is reduced to 10. All other restrictions still apply.

name: Leech-Craft
entries: You are skilled, according to ancient traditions, in the healing of wounds and sickness. As an action, you can spend a craft slot to tend to a creature within 5 feet of you and make a {@dc 10} Intelligence ({@skill Medicine}) check. You can spend one use of a {@item healer's kit|PHB} to replace the {@dice d20} roll with a 10. If you succeed, the creature regains a number of hit points equal to your check result minus 10 (minimum 1 hit point).
When you reach 5th level, on a successful check you can alternatively cure the target of one disease or neutralise one poison affecting it.

name: Lethal Body
entries: You possess potent vampiric strength, turning your bare hands into deadly weapons.

entries.name: Crushing Blows
entries: You can deal {@damage 1d8} extra damage when you hit a target with an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}. The extra damage is the same type dealt by that strike.

entries.name: Iron Grip
entries: A creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on ability checks and saving throws to escape your grapple.

name: Light Foot
entries: You are exceptionally speedy and agile. You gain the following benefits:

items: While you aren't wearing heavy armor, you gain a +1 bonus to your AC.
Whenever you take the {@action Attack} action, you can forgo one of your attacks to move up to half your speed.
Nonmagical {@quickref difficult terrain||3} costs you no extra movement.
You can move through a hostile creature's space, regardless of its size.

name: Lightning Caster
entries: Your rapid-fire style of casting cantrips allows you to weave magic with uncanny speed. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Dual Target
entries: When you cast a cantrip with a casting time of an action that targets a single creature, you can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to target a second creature within the cantrip's range.

entries.name: Immediate Response
entries: When you cast a spell as a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}, that spell doesn't expend a spell slot. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Lightning Mastery
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Thor's Fury
entries: Your lightning spells are laced with extra power. Whenever you deal Lightning damage to a creature with a spell of at least 1st level, you can choose one of the following additional effects.

items: The creature has the {@condition Stunned} condition until the end of your next turn, if it failed its save against the spell.

The creature takes half of the Lightning damage it initially took again at the beginning of its next turn. It can make a saving throw against your spell saving throw DC to negate this additional damage.

The creature gains {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} to Lightning damage for 1 minute. It can make a Constitution saving throw (equal to your spell saving throw DC) to end this effect at the end of each of its turns.

entries: You can use Thor's Fury a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Living off the Land
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Herbalist
entries: When you take a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} in a natural area (natural caves, forest, tundra, etc.), you can locate materials to create a {@item Healer's Kit|XPHB}, and enough mushrooms, berries, or root vegetables to feed one Medium creature for one day.

entries.name: Survival Shelter
entries: You can spend 30 minutes to create a lean-to, bivouac, tree well, igloo, or other temporary shelter out of snow, tree boughs, rocks, and sticks, suitable for 4-5 Medium humanoids. While inside your survival shelter, creatures automatically succeed on Constitution saving throws against {@hazard Extreme Cold|XDMG} and {@hazard Extreme Heat|XDMG}.

name: Long Haft Strike
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Bypass Shield
entries: When you make an attack with a weapon with the Reach property against a creature wielding a {@item Shield|XPHB}, that creature doesn't benefit from the {@item Shield|XPHB}'s {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} bonus.

entries.name: Reaching Defense
entries: While wielding a weapon with reach, you have a +1 bonus to your {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB}.

name: Loyal Servant
entries: You have a loyal companion who has gained power from your blood. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Companion
entries: A loyal Beast or Humanoid is Blood Bound to you. {@filter Choose a Beast or Humanoid stat block|bestiary|Challenge Rating=[&0;&3]|type=beast;humanoid} that has a maximum {@variantrule Challenge Rating|XPHB} of up to half your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}. When choosing a companion, you may look in the monster section of source books or elsewhere for an eligible Beast or Humanoid if the Game Master permits you to do so.

entries.name: Power in the Blood
entries: Your Loyal Servant has one {@filter Kindred feat|feats|category=kf|level=level 1;level 2} of your choice, and it counts as a level 2 Kindred for the purpose of selecting a Kindred feat. In addition, your Loyal Servant can spend 1 {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die} in place of 1 Blood Point for the purpose of its feat.

entries.name: Replacing a Servant
entries: If your servant is killed or otherwise leaves, you can choose a new Loyal Servant after 30 days. The GM can lengthen or shorten this time based on in-game circumstances.

entries.name: The Blood Bond
entries: While Blood Bound to a Kindred, a creature is considered {@condition Charmed|XPHB} by that Kindred and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid being {@condition Charmed|XPHB} or {@condition Frightened|XPHB} by other creatures. This is in addition to the effects from the {@item Kindred Vitae|BoundByBlood} consumable.

A Blood Bond can be suppressed for 1 minute if the creature succeeds on a DC 25 Charisma saving throw. The bond is only permanently removed if the creature doesn't drink from that Kindred again for a year, or if the Kindred in question is killed.

name: Magically Mischievous
entries: You've picked up a few magical tricks that assist your nefarious skills. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Sleight of Hand} skill. If you already have proficiency, you gain expertise instead, which means your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make with it.

When you succeed on a Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check to steal something, you can magically turn the object you stole {@condition invisible} as part of the same action, as if you had cast the {@spell Obscure Object|ObojimaTallGrass} spell. The object must be small enough to fit in the palm of your hand, and this effect lasts for 1 minute. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

name: Magitechnician
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Magic Item Expert
entries: If one of your magic items calls for a saving throw, it uses the following DC if it is higher: 8 plus the modifier of the ability increased by this feat and your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}.

entries.name: Magic Item Recharge
entries: When you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, you can cause a magic item that regains charges or properties to recharge as if it were the next dawn. Once you use this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Marksman's Luck
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Flip Die
entries: Once per turn, when you roll for damage with a Ranged weapon, you can flip one of the damage dice over and use the number on the bottom. You can't use this ability on d4s. Note that for a balanced die, the top and bottom numbers add up to one more than the die's largest number.

entries.name: Enhanced Critical
entries: When you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} with a Ranged weapon, the target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is 0 until the end of its next turn.

name: Mastery
entries: You have practised certain skills until they have become as natural as breathing.

items: You gain one skill, tool, or weapon proficiency of your choice.
Choose one of your skill or tool proficiencies. You gain Expertise with that skill or tool, which means your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make with it.

name: Medician of the Morbus Doctore
entries: You are a master of the medical sciences because of your association with a medical institute. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Adept Medic
entries: When you use the Blood and Bone benefit of the Triage Expert feat, the creature can spend up to three {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} instead of one.

entries.name: Battle Surgeon
entries: When you use the Blood and Bone benefit of the Triage Expert feat, the creature can spend three {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} to end one of the following conditions on itself instead of regaining {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}: {@condition Blinded|XPHB}, {@condition Deafened|XPHB}, {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB}, {@condition Poisoned|XPHB}, or {@condition Stunned|XPHB}.
Alternatively, you can cure one {@variantrule Grievous Wounds|GrimHollowCG24|Grievous Wound} affecting the creature.

name: Member of AHA

prerequisite.other: You must be a member of AHA

entries: You have become an official member of AHA. You gain the following benefits:

items: You learn the {@spell Jolt|ObojimaTallGrass} cantrip. You also learn one of the following spells of your choice: {@spell Comprehend Languages}, {@spell Detect Magic}, {@spell Identify}, or {@spell Illusory Script}. You can cast the chosen spell once without expending a spell slot, and you must finish a long rest before you can cast it in this way again. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

name: Memory of Ancient Days
entries: Long centuries and uncounted generations of Men seem but a little while to the Elves. Your memories go back to a time before Eriador became desolate, and your knowledge of the land is returning to you now that you are travelling again outside the boundaries of your realm.

items: You can give yourself a bonus to {@book pathfinding checks|TLotRR|4|2. Make Pathfinding Checks} equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of +1).

When you are targeted by a journey event, the roll on the Journey Events table is done as if you were in a Border Land if you are in a Wild Land, and as if you were in a Wild Land if you are in a Dark Land.

name: Memory Starved
entries: Your mind ravenously gathers details and desperately clings to its memories and faculties, granting you the following benefits.

entries.name: Desperate Detail
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|XPHB}) checks.

entries.name: Iron Mind
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws made to avoid or end the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition and to avoid having your memories read or altered.

name: Metabolistic Magic
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Arcane Skill
entries: When you fail a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}, you can expend a spell slot to gain a bonus to the roll, potentially causing it to succeed. The bonus equals 2 plus the level of the spell slot expended.

entries.name: Vital Fuel
entries: When you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, you can expend a number of {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} up to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} to recover expended spell slots. Choose spell slots to recover that have a combined level equal to no more than the number of {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} expended. Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Mind Tricks
entries: You can dominate others with your mental powers. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Cloud Memory
entries: You can cast the {@spell Command|XPHB} spell without expending a spell slot a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. In addition, you gain access to a special command.

entries.name: Forget
entries: The target has only a hazy and unsure recollection of the last 5 minutes.

name: Minor Corruption
entries: You were exposed to the Corruption, a dark magic that's poisoning the island. It's now begun to alter you as well. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain a +1 bonus to AC while you have less than half of your hit points remaining.

You can draw upon the Corruption within you to channel your magical power. You don't need to use a spellcasting focus for your spells, allowing you to ignore the material components specified for the spell, unless the component indicates a cost or is consumed by the spell.

As a reaction, when you take damage, you can temporarily negate an amount of the damage equal to three times your level; you take any excess damage as normal. At the end of your next turn, you must make a Constitution saving throw, the DC of which is equal to 10 or one-third the damage you would have taken, whichever number is higher. On a failed save, you immediately take the negated damage. You must continue to make a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of your turns for 1 minute or until you fail the save, at which point you take the negated damage. Once you take this reaction, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

name: Mobile Combatant
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Slippery
entries: When you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action, your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 10 feet and {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks} have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} against you until the end of your turn.

name: Moon-Touched
entries: Your connection to the moon and its otherworldly radiance grants you the following benefits.

entries.name: Moon Magic
entries: You know your choice of the {@spell Dancing Lights|XPHB} or {@spell Light|XPHB} cantrip. Choose one level 1 spell that creates or emits light, such as {@spell Color Spray|XPHB} or {@spell Faerie Fire|XPHB}, from the Druid, Sorcerer, or Wizard spell lists. You always have that spell and the {@spell Moonbeam} spell prepared. You can cast each of these spells without expending a spell slot. Once you cast either spell in this way, you can't cast that spell in this way again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spells' spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.

name: Mounted Leap
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Equestrian Prowess
entries: While you're riding a mount, that mount's jump distance is doubled.

entries.name: Leaping Charge Attack
entries: While jumping from a moving mount, your jump distance is calculated using the mount's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} in place of yours (if its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is better than yours). If you make a successful melee attack roll against a creature after jumping, choose one of the following effects: gain a {@dice 1d8} bonus to the attack's damage roll, or make the target have the {@condition Prone} condition if the target is one size category larger than you or smaller. You can use this benefit only once on each of your turns.

name: Mystic Conflux
entries: You possess an intuitive understanding of the way magic ebbs and flows within enchanted items. Such items attune easily to you, and you are able to sound out their secrets. You gain the following benefits:

items: You can attune to up to four magic items at once.
You can cast the {@spell identify} spell without expending a spell slot or material components. You must finish a {@quickref resting|PHB|2|0|long rest} before you can do so again.

name: Nakudama's Electric Bloodline
entries: Although it's uncommon in today's day and age, some Nakudama are able to awaken the now dormant skills held by their warring ancestors. You gain the following benefits:

items: You have resistance to lightning damage.

You have an electrified tongue that you can use to make unarmed strikes. It has the finesse and reach properties, and when you hit with it, the strike deals lightning damage equal to {@dice 1d6} + your Strength or Dexterity modifier, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike. The damage from your tongue increases when you reach 5th level ({@dice 1d8}), 11th level ({@dice 1d10}), and 17th level ({@dice 1d12}).

When you become {@condition grappled} by a creature, you can use your reaction to force the creature to make a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus). On a failed save, the creature takes {@damage 1d10} lightning damage and the grapple ends.

name: Nakudama's Toxin Bloodline
