entries: Although it's uncommon in today's day and age, some Nakudama are able to awaken the now dormant skills held by their warring ancestors. You gain the following benefits:

items: You have resistance to poison damage.
You have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition poisoned}.

You can cause your cheeks to swell and bubble out as your mouth fills with liquid poison. As an action, you can spit several globs of poison in quick succession, targeting a number of creatures equal to your proficiency bonus. Each target must be within 30 feet of you and must make a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus). A target takes poison damage equal to {@dice 1d8} + your proficiency bonus on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Nimble Physique
entries: You are small and thin for your species. You have a mysterious and consistent ability to avoid danger. You gain the following benefits:

items.name: Dodgy
entries: While you aren't wearing armor or wielding a {@item Shield|XPHB}, you can take the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

items.name: Slippery
entries: While you are {@condition Grappled|XPHB} or {@condition Restrained|XPHB}, your attacks don't have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} and attacks against you don't have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.

name: Nimbleness
entries: Your skill (or fortune?) in battle has increased with your growth in experience.

items: You gain a +1 bonus to AC. You lose this bonus if you are {@condition incapacitated} or wielding a shield.

name: Nocturnal
entries: You have spent many formative years in the darkness of night. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You have {@spell Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet. If you already have {@spell Darkvision|XPHB}, its range increases by 30 feet.

entries.name: Slink in Shadows
entries: Whenever you make a Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) check while in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} or {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}, you can treat a roll of 9 or lower on the {@dice d20} as a 10.

name: Norn-Touched
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Fates' Favor
entries: Once per day, when you make a {@variantrule d20 Test|XPHB}, you can add your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} to the result. You can see the result of the roll before you use this feature.

entries.name: Fates' Scorn
entries: Once per day, when another creature rolls a {@dice d20} for an attack roll or ability check, you can subtract your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} from the result. You can see the result of the roll before you use this feature.

name: Northern Raider
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Born on the Water
entries: You gain proficiency in {@item navigator's tools|XPHB}.

entries.name: Blood in the Water
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and ability checks that you make the turn that you exit the water or exit a ship.

name: Northlands Hardiness
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Cold Weather Resilience
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against {@hazard Extreme Cold|XDMG}. If you already have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Cold damage, you also gain {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against Cold damage.

entries.name: Inexhaustible
entries: The first time in a day that you receive a level of {@condition Exhaustion}, your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is not reduced. In addition, you may ignore the effects of {@condition Exhaustion} on a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}.

name: Opportunist
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Exploit Weakness
entries: Whenever you make an attack as part of a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}, you gain a +2 bonus to the attack and damage rolls.

name: Opportunistic Thief
entries: You have learned the tricks of the trade of thievery, allowing you to exploit opportunities for pick-pocketing both in and out of combat. You gain the following benefits:

items: When a creature fails a melee attack roll against you in combat, you can make a Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check against a DC equal to 10 + the target's Dexterity modifier. On a success, you may steal any one item that is not being held or worn by the target.

Whenever you successfully use your {@skill Sleight of Hand} skill outside of combat to steal an object, you may immediately conceal it flawlessly on your person, or put another object you possess in its place.

activation.condition: When a creature fails a melee attack roll against you in combat

name: Orb Expert
entries: Your skill with magical {@item Orb|XPHB|Orbs} helps you evade enemies while overcoming their defenses. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Fortune Teller
entries: When you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, roll {@dice 1d6} and record the result. When you cast a spell using an {@item Orb|XPHB} as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB}, you can add the result of this prescience roll to your spell attack roll, or reduce one target's saving throw by that amount. You must choose to do so before the attack roll or saving throw.

Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. Unused prescience rolls are lost when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: See the Path
entries: While you are holding an {@item Orb|XPHB}, {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks} against you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

entries.name: Prescient Escape
entries: While you are holding an {@item Orb|XPHB}, whenever a creature you can see enters a space within 5 feet of you, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to move up to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} without provoking an {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB}.

name: Pack Fighting
entries: When you make a melee attack with a weapon or an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} against a creature, you gain a +1 bonus to the damage roll if at least one of your allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition. If at least one ally within 5 feet of the creature also has this feat and doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition, this bonus increases to +2.

name: Perfect Landing
entries: Years of living at great heights have taught you how to fall more gracefully. You gain the following benefits:

items: Reduce the damage die for fall damage from a d6 to a {@dice d4}.
You do not fall prone after taking falling damage.
You do not take damage for the first 30 feet of your fall.

name: Plantmender
entries: One of the basic forms of Tender magic, plantmending is often taught to seedlings of the order. Plantmending can be used either to help the forest recover from disasters or to defend against hazards that might be encountered while traveling. You gain the following benefits:

items: You can touch a plant or tree as an action to determine what has occurred to it and the area within its immediate vicinity within the last 24 hours. These events are revealed to you in visions that appear as though you were present as they occurred. After using this ability on a plant, you instantly become aware of its status and health, including any blights or conditions currently affecting it. You can use this ability a number of times equal to twice your Wisdom modifier (minimum of 1), regaining expended uses of it when you complete a long rest.
You learn the {@spell mend plants|HumblewoodTales}{@cite New Humblewood Content|HumblewoodTales|*} and {@spell shillelagh} cantrips. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

You can cast either the {@spell barkskin} or {@spell spike growth} spell once, and you must complete a long rest before you can cast either spell again. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

name: Postal Knight

prerequisite.other: You must be a member of the Courier Brigade

entries: You have trained as a member of the Courier Brigade. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Athletics} and {@skill Survival} skills.
{@condition Exhaustion} doesn't cause you to have disadvantage on ability checks.

name: Potion Brewer
entries: Your expertise and understanding of magical potions and elixirs allow you to finesse ingredients and recipes to your specifications. You gain the following benefits:

items: When brewing potions, you can choose to take the second-highest ingredient attribute number from your potion recipe, instead of the first.
When brewing a potion, you can roll percentile dice. If you roll a number equal to or lower than your level, you create two potions instead of one.

name: Primal
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Primal Magic
entries: Choose two of the following spells: {@spell Animal Friendship|XPHB}, {@spell Entangle|XPHB}, {@spell Goodberry|XPHB}, or {@spell Speak with Animals|XPHB}. You always have those two spells and the {@spell Barkskin|XPHB} spell prepared. You can cast each of these spells without expending a spell slot. Once you cast a spell in this way, you can't cast that spell in this way again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spells' spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.

name: Prone Defense
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Defensive
entries: When you have the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition, you don't have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls. {@action Attack|XPHB} rolls against you don't have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} because of the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

entries.name: Hop Up
entries: When you have the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition, you can right yourself with only 5 feet of movement.

name: Prone Fighting
entries: While you have the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition, you don't have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} due to the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition on attack rolls, and the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition doesn't grant {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls made against you.

name: Protected
entries: You have someone or something guarding you for as long as you can remember, even if you don't know why. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Luck Points
entries: You have a number of Luck Points equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} and can spend the points on the benefits below. You regain your expended Luck Points when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Reroll
entries: Whenever you make a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB} and roll 9 or lower on the {@dice d20}, you can spend 1 Luck Point to reroll the {@dice d20}. You must accept the second result.

entries.name: Stabilize
entries: When you are reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and not killed outright, you can spend 1 Luck Point to drop to 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} instead.

name: Prowess
entries: Adventuring has honed your inborn talents.

items: Increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or two ability scores of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.

name: Pyromaniac
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Firestarter Magic
entries: You know the {@spell Fire Bolt|XPHB} cantrip and you always have the {@spell Burning Hands|XPHB} and {@spell Scorching Ray|XPHB} spells prepared. You can cast {@spell Burning Hands|XPHB} and {@spell Scorching Ray|XPHB} without expending a spell slot. Once you cast either spell in this way, you can't cast that spell in this way again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spellcasting ability for this feat's spells is the ability increased by this feat.

entries.name: Flare Damage
entries: Whenever you deal Fire damage and roll the highest number on any damage die, you can roll that damage die again and add it to the damage, rolling again if it is the highest number, and so on. You can add a maximum number of dice to the damage roll equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} (minimum of 1).

name: Quori Bond
entries: You possess a particularly strong bond with your quori spirit. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Quori Lineage
entries: Choose a lineage from the Quori Lineages table. Your choice affects the Skill and Spell sections detailed below.
{@i * when cast using this feat, {@spell Shatter|XPHB} deals Psychic damage}

entries.name: Skill
entries: When you make an ability check with the skill associated with your quori lineage, you can roll {@dice 1d4} and add the number rolled to the ability check.

entries.name: Spell
entries: You always have the spell associated with your quori lineage prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Your spellcasting ability for the spell is the ability increased by this feat.

items.name: Skill (Du'ulora)
entries: When you make a Charisma ({@skill Intimidation|XPHB}) check, you can roll {@dice 1d4} and add the number rolled to the ability check.

items.name: Spell (Du'ulora)
entries: You always have the {@spell Crown of Madness|XPHB} spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Your spellcasting ability for the spell is the ability increased by this feat.

items.name: Skill (Hashataq)
entries: When you make a Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|XPHB}) check, you can roll {@dice 1d4} and add the number rolled to the ability check.

items.name: Spell (Hashataq)
entries: You always have the {@spell Suggestion|XPHB} spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Your spellcasting ability for the spell is the ability increased by this feat.

items.name: Skill (Kalaraq)
entries: When you make a Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) check, you can roll {@dice 1d4} and add the number rolled to the ability check.

items.name: Spell (Kalaraq)
entries: You always have the {@spell Mind Spike|XPHB} spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Your spellcasting ability for the spell is the ability increased by this feat.

items.name: Skill (Tsucora)
entries: When you make a Charisma ({@skill Intimidation|XPHB}) check, you can roll {@dice 1d4} and add the number rolled to the ability check.

items.name: Spell (Tsucora)
entries: You always have the {@spell Shatter|XPHB} (when cast using this feat it deals Psychic damage) spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Your spellcasting ability for the spell is the ability increased by this feat.

name: Raider's Rush
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against any creature within 5 feet of one of your allies if you move at least 15 feet and stop within 5 feet of that ally.

name: Ravens' Friend
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Quick Study
entries: You gain proficiency in your choice of one of the following skills: {@skill Arcana}, {@skill History}, {@skill Investigation}, {@skill Nature}, or {@skill Religion}.

entries.name: Raven's Whispers
entries: Ravens sometimes tell you secrets. When you take the {@action Study} action, you can give yourself {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the roll. You can do this a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Reapmaster
entries: Few hunters can match your knowledge and skill in obtaining pristine components.

items: You gain proficiency in one skill from the following options: Arcana, Investigation, Medicine, Nature, Religion, or Survival.
When you make a Harvesting check using a skill with which you are proficient, you have advantage on the roll.

name: Remarkable Recovery
entries: Your body has the ability to recover quickly from terrible injuries, and is unusually receptive to healing magic. You gain the following benefits:

items: When you are successfully stabilized while dying, you regain hit points equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1).
Whenever you regain hit points as a result of a spell, potion, or class feature (but not this feat), you regain additional hit points equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1).

name: Resolution of the Syndicate
entries: Membership in the Ebon Syndicate provides perks—one of which is the motivation that comes with the understanding that the Syndicate kills those who fail too often. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Quick Strike
entries: On your first turn after an {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} roll, add {@dice 1d4} to the first damage roll you make. This extra damage increases to {@dice 2d4} at character level 9, and to {@dice 4d4} at character level 16.

entries.name: Resilient
entries: Your {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum increases by an amount equal to your character level when you gain this feat. Whenever you gain a character level thereafter, your {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum increases by an additional 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point}.

name: Reveling Fool
entries: You joined a troupe of madcap revelers and learned to take on the guise of a fool, channeling otherworldly laughter and joviality. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Fool's Mask
entries: By donning a jovial mask and a fool's, jester's, or clown's costume, you take on a new identity that hides your own. In the guise of the fool, you can get away with minor transgressions against people in positions of authority or station.

entries.name: Jester's Repartee
entries: You always have the {@spell Tasha's Hideous Laughter|XPHB|Hideous Laughter} spell prepared, and your spellcasting ability for it is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (choose the ability when you select this feat). You can cast it once without Material components or a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have.

name: Reward
entries: You choose a reward (see {@book Chapter 4|TLotRR|3|Rewards}).

entries.name: Special
entries: You may take this feature multiple times.

name: Rod Expert
entries: You've mastered the use of a {@item Rod|XPHB} as an Arcane Focus. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Close-Ranged Focus
entries: If the target of a cantrip you cast using a {@item Rod|XPHB} as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB} is within 20 feet of you when you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll, even if the new roll is a 1 or a 2.

entries.name: Unshakeable Casting
entries: When you make a ranged spell attack roll while using a {@item Rod|XPHB} as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB}, you do not have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the roll if you are within 5 feet of an enemy.

entries.name: Rough & Tumble
entries: When you make a ranged spell attack while using a {@item Rod|XPHB} as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB}, you can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to make a melee attack with your {@item Rod|XPHB}. It counts as a {@item Club|XPHB} for the purposes of the attack.

name: Royalty Revealed
entries: Your kin belong to a bloodline of kings, but they have learnt to hide from their enemies in the twilight years of their kingdom. Should you choose to reveal your heritage, your noble bearing will cause your allies to cast away their doubts. You reveal yourself by shouting an ancestral battle-cry, or unsheathing a weapon of high lineage, or by showing a device or coat of arms.

items: As a bonus action, you can choose to reveal your lineage. When you do so, choose a number of friendly creatures (which can include yourself) within 30 feet of you who can see or hear you, up to twice your proficiency bonus. Until the end of your next turn, each creature gains advantage on attack rolls and Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) checks, and is immune to being {@condition frightened}. It also gains temporary hit points equal to your choice of your Strength or Charisma modifier (minimum 1). These temporary hit points last until they are depleted or the creature finishes a short or long rest. Once you use this virtue, you cannot use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

name: Rune-Craft
entries: You can now read and write runic inscriptions. You can use the runes to convey secret messages to other creatures who know them, or whom you previously instructed in their meaning.

At the end of a short or long rest, you can spend a craft slot and choose a magical item in the Company's possession. Make an Intelligence ({@skill Old Lore|TLotRR}) check. The DC is 10 for a Marvellous Artefact, 15 for a Wondrous Item, or 20 for a Famous Weapon or Armour. If you succeed, you learn all there is to be discovered about the item's qualities, and whether it is cursed or not.

In addition, during a Fellowship Phase, you can spend a craft slot to inscribe runes of power on a non-magical item of your choice, or on two items when you reach 5th level. You must be proficient with the tools related to the substance of which the item you choose is made ({@item smith's tools|PHB} for metal, {@item woodcarver's tools|PHB} for wood, etc.). While a creature holds or wears the item, it gains a +1 bonus to saving throws. If the item is a shield or a weapon, you may attribute it a bane instead (see {@book Chapter 7|TLotRR|6|Famous Weapons and Armour}). Choose a creature type among Evil Men, Orcs, Spiders, Trolls, Undead, or Wolves. If the item has one or more rewards, their effects are doubled against bane creatures (for example, a Keen weapon scores a critical hit on a roll of 18–20 against bane creatures). The runes can only be inscribed once on each item, and you cannot regain a craft slot expended in this way until the next Fellowship Phase, when you can cancel the runes inscribed with that slot and regain the slot, if you wish.

name: Sangromantic Initiate
entries: You have become adept enough with weaving blood magic to mitigate some of the harm of Sangromancy. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Blood Magic
entries: Choose a {@filter Sangromancy spell|spells|subschool=sangromancy} from any spell list of a level for which you have spell slots. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slot you have.

entries.name: Sanguine Potency
entries: You have a pool of two d12s that you can expend instead of {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} when you cast {@filter Sangromancy spells|spells|subschool=sangromancy}. Your pool regains all expended dice when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Savagery
entries: When you make your first melee weapon attack roll on your turn, you can decide to attack savagely. Doing so allows you to add your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} to your melee weapon damage rolls but lowers your AC by 2 until the start of your next turn.

name: Scourge Master
entries: Your skill with whips and tetherhooks allows you to manipulate items at a distance.

items: When you hit a creature with an attack using a {@item tetherhooks|HelianasGuidetoMonsterHunting} or {@item whip|PHB}, you can use a bonus action to attempt to disarm the creature of a shield, or of one item it is holding. Make a Strength or Dexterity check (your choice) contested by the target's Strength check. If you succeed, the item is dropped on the ground midway between you and the creature.
You can use your {@item whip|PHB} or {@item tetherhooks|HelianasGuidetoMonsterHunting} to grab items weighing less than 1 lb within the reach of your weapon, pulling them back to your person.

name: Sea Wolf
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Tactical Boarder
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength ({@skill Athletics}) and Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) checks made to board vehicles.

entries.name: Reaver's Ferocity
entries: When you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} against a creature with a melee attack, you can make another melee attack against the same creature or an adjacent creature as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

name: Self-Control
entries: You manage your Beast better than many. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Reining the Beast
entries: When you would be affected by the {@classFeature The Beast|Kindred|BoundByBlood|1||Hunger} of your Beast feature, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to immediately end the effect.
You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Shadow's Gift of Stone
entries: You have learned to channel arcane power through your gaze. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Innate Magic
entries: When you reach a character level specified in the Shadow's Gift of Stone Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared. You can cast each of these spells once without expending a spell slot, and you must finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} before you can cast them in this way again. You can also cast these spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.
Your spellcasting ability for these spells is the same as the spellcasting ability you chose for your Petrifying Gaze trait.

name: Shadowsteel Adept
entries: You have learned to tap into the dangerous but powerful art of Shadowsteel casting. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Curse Caster
entries: You always have {@filter Shadowsteel curses|spells|subschool=shadowsteel curse} prepared, and you can cast them with any spell slots you have.

entries.name: Shadowsteel's Bite
entries: While holding your {@item Shadowsteel Focus|GrimHollowPG24}, you gain a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls and to the saving throw DCs of your spells.

entries.name: Shadowsteel Weapon
entries: If your {@item Shadowsteel Focus|GrimHollowPG24} is also a weapon, that weapon has a +1 bonus to weapon attack rolls and damage rolls.

name: Shadowsteel Master
entries: Your mastery over Shadowsteel grows stronger. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Necrotic Harmony
entries: While holding your {@item Shadowsteel Focus|GrimHollowPG24}, when you cast a spell that targets one or more creatures and requires an attack roll or saving throw, you can choose one target you hit or who failed the saving throw to also take {@damage 1d4} Necrotic damage for each spell slot level expended to cast the spell.

entries.name: Necrotic Weapon
entries: If your {@item Shadowsteel Focus|GrimHollowPG24} is also a weapon, that weapon has a +2 bonus to weapon attack rolls and damage rolls. Additionally, once on each of your turns, when you hit a creature with a weapon attack roll using your {@item Shadowsteel Focus|GrimHollowPG24}, you can cause the target to take an extra {@damage 2d8} Necrotic damage.

name: Shield Wall
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Shield Ally
entries: When a creature you can see hits an ally adjacent to you with an attack, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to grant your ally your {@item Shield|XPHB}'s {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} bonus against the triggering attack.

entries.name: Shoulder to Shoulder
entries: When you and an ally are both wielding a {@item Shield|XPHB} and are adjacent to each other, you both gain a +1 bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB}.

name: Shifting Combatant
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Domino Strike
entries: When you hit a creature with a weapon and activate the Push mastery property to push that creature into a space occupied by a Large or smaller creature, you can force the creatures to collide. Each creature makes a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus the ability modifier of the score increased by this feat and your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}), taking {@damage 1d10} Bludgeoning damage on a failed save.

entries.name: Fearless Leap
entries: When you make a {@variantrule Long Jump|XPHB}, moving at least 10 feet immediately before the jump, and land in a space within 5 feet of two or more enemies, attack rolls made against you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} until the start of your next turn.

name: Shock Trooper
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: First Strike
entries: When you roll {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} and don't have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the roll, you can draw a weapon and make an attack using it.

entries.name: Rapid Advance
entries: During the first round of each combat, your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is doubled.

name: Showman
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Expert Performer
entries: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Performance|XPHB} skill. If you already have proficiency in it, you gain {@variantrule Expertise|XPHB} in it.

entries.name: Taunt
entries: You can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to mock a creature within 15 feet of yourself. If the target can hear you (though it need not understand you), it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the next attack roll it makes against a creature other than you before the end of its next turn. You can use this {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Skirmisher
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Mobility
entries: Your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 10 feet.

entries.name: Strike and Fade
entries: Once on each of your turns, you can deal extra damage equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} to a creature you hit with an attack that deals Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage, as long as you have moved 15 feet prior to making the attack.

name: Small Folk
entries: Hobbits are a little people, but their resourcefulness far exceeds their stature. You have learnt how to exploit your small size to your advantage in a fight.

items: Medium or larger creatures cannot gain advantage on attack rolls against you while you are not {@condition incapacitated}.
You don't provoke {@action opportunity attack||opportunity attacks} from Medium or larger creatures.

name: Sneak Attack
entries: You gain the {@classFeature Sneak Attack|Treasure Hunter|TLotRR|1|TLotRR} feature. The extra damage is {@dice 1d6}.

You know how to strike subtly and exploit a foe's distraction. Once per turn, you can deal an extra {@dice 1d6} damage to one creature you hit with an attack if you have advantage on the attack roll. The attack must use a {@itemProperty F||finesse} or a ranged weapon.
You don't need advantage on the attack roll if another enemy of the target is within 5 feet of it, that enemy isn't {@condition incapacitated}, and you don't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

name: Snowrunner
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Ice Walking
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws and ability checks to maintain your balance on slippery surfaces and on snow.

entries.name: Winter's Edge
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) checks in snowy or icy terrain.

name: Song-Craft
entries: You have been trained in the art of singing, according to the tradition of the wandering minstrels. Your musical lore runs deeper than most, as you partake of the knowledge of the mighty singers of old. As an action, you can spend a craft slot and make a Charisma ({@skill Performance}) check, contested by the Intelligence ({@skill Riddle|TLotRR}) check of each creature of your choice within 30 feet of you that can hear you. A creature can choose to fail its ability check if it wishes. For each target against which you win the contest, choose one of the following options:

items: You can suppress any effect causing the target to be {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened} until the end of your next turn. This effect ends if the target can no longer hear you.

You can make the target indifferent about creatures of your choice that it is hostile towards until the end of your next turn. The target also has disadvantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks made to perceive any creature other than you for the same duration. This effect ends if the target can no longer hear you, it is harmed, or if it witnesses any of its friends being harmed.

Until the end of your next turn, whenever the target makes an attack roll or a saving throw, the target must roll a {@dice d4} and either add the number rolled to the attack roll or saving throw (if the target is friendly to you), or subtract it (if the target is hostile). This effect ends if the target can no longer hear you.

entries: When you reach 5th level, you can use a bonus action on each of your turns to extend the duration of each of these effects on all targets until the end of your next turn, up to 1 minute.

name: Spear Expert
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Deflecting Haft
entries: You can use a {@item Spear|XPHB} to deflect incoming attacks. While holding a {@item Spear|XPHB}, you gain a +1 bonus to your AC.

entries.name: Expert Thrower
entries: The range of any {@item Spear|XPHB} you throw is 30/90.

entries.name: Spear Ready
entries: If you take the {@action Ready} action to attack with the {@item Spear|XPHB}, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the triggered attack.

name: Speech of the Ancient Beasts
entries: You have a special connection with the natural world. Great beasts regard you as their kin, and you possess the ability to speak the languages of the most powerful and mystic of their kind. You gain the following benefits:

items: Beasts of Large size or larger have a friendly disposition toward you unless you have attacked them.
You have advantage on Charisma checks made against beasts that are of Large size or larger.

You can speak and understand {@language Giant Eagle|MM}, {@language Giant Elk|MM}, and {@language Giant Owl|MM}. You can otherwise be understood by any beast of Large size or larger, whether or not they speak a language. Beasts with Intelligence scores of 4 or lower may only be able to understand simple concepts.

name: Speech-Craft
entries: You are a student of {@language Sindarin|TLotRR} and {@language Quenya|TLotRR}, the Ancient Tongue, and have advantage on Charisma checks when interacting with Elves.

In addition, as an action you can spend a craft slot and choose a creature other than an Elf, or a Wizard, or a similarly powerful creature, within 30 feet of you who can hear you. Then, choose one of the following options:

items: Make a Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) check contested by the target's Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) check. A target has advantage on this check if it is Large or larger or if it cannot understand you. If you win the contest, the target is {@condition frightened} of you for 1 minute. The {@condition frightened} target can make a Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) check against your passive Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) score at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. When you reach 5th level, you can target one additional creature, or two additional creatures at 9th level.

Make a Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) or Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check contested by the target's Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check. A target has advantage on this check if it is immune to being {@condition charmed} or if it cannot understand you. If you win the contest, you can speak a one-word command that the target must follow on its next turn, if it can and if the command is not directly harmful to it. Once the target has executed the command, it ends its turn. Some typical commands include {@i "Fall!"} (the target falls {@condition prone}), {@i "Flee!"} (the target moves away from you), and {@i "Halt!"} (the target doesn't move and takes no actions), and the effect may be considered a Misdeed depending on the circumstances. When you reach 5th level, you can target one additional creature, or two additional creatures at 9th level.

name: Spellblade
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Blade Cantrips
entries: You learn two of the following cantrips of your choice: {@spell Arc Blade|ValdaPlayerPack2}, {@spell Burning Blade|ValdaPlayerPack2}, {@spell Frigid Blade|ValdaPlayerPack2}, or {@spell True Strike|XPHB}. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells (choose when you select this feat). Whenever you gain a new level, you can change your cantrip selection.

entries.name: Arcane Strike
entries: When you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action on your turn, you can replace one of the attacks with casting {@spell Arc Blade|ValdaPlayerPack2}, {@spell Burning Blade|ValdaPlayerPack2}, {@spell Frigid Blade|ValdaPlayerPack2}, or {@spell True Strike|XPHB}.

entries.name: Channeled Attack
entries: When you make an attack using Strength or Dexterity with a weapon with which you have proficiency, you can gain a bonus to the attack roll equal to your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma modifier (minimum of +1). Choose the ability each time you use this benefit. You can gain this bonus a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Spelldriver
entries: Through intense focus, training, and dedication, you've harnessed the techniques of rapid spellcasting.

When you use your bonus action to cast a spell of 1st level or higher, you can also use your action to cast another spell of 1st level or higher. However, if you cast two or more spells in a single turn, only one of them can be 3rd level or higher.

entries.name: Rules Tip: Casting Multiple Spells
entries: Normally, when you cast a spell as a bonus action, you can't use your action to also cast a spell that turn unless that spell is a cantrip—{@note see {@book PHB p202|PHB|10|Bonus Action}.} The Spelldriver feat removes that restriction, but the focus necessary to channel multiple spells in the same round still limits the overall power of those spells.

name: Spray 'n' Pray

otherSummary.entry: Proficiency with a magitech firearm or {@item tommybow|HelianasGuidetoMonsterHunting}

entries: You've learned to unleash the full potential of mechanised ranged weapons, leaving aiming down to lady luck. You gain the following benefits:

items: You can reload firearms and {@item tommybow|HelianasGuidetoMonsterHunting|tommybows} as a bonus action or an action.
Being within 5 feet of a hostile creature doesn't impose disadvantage on your ranged attack rolls.
When you use the Attack action and attack with a one-handed weapon, you can use a bonus action to attack with a one-handed firearm or {@item tommybow|HelianasGuidetoMonsterHunting} you are holding.

After you take the Attack action with a {@item tommybow|HelianasGuidetoMonsterHunting} or magitech firearm, you can use a bonus action to quickly make one or two additional ranged weapon attacks using the same weapon. If you choose to make two attacks, you take a -5 penalty to both attack rolls. You don't add your ability modifier to the damage of the bonus attack(s), unless that modifier is negative.

name: Staff Expert
entries: You've unlocked the deadly ranged potential of the {@item Staff|XPHB}. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Arcane Artillery
entries: When you cast a spell that has a range of 5 feet or greater using a {@item Staff|XPHB} as your {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB}, you can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to double the range of the spell.

entries.name: Powerful Focus
entries: When you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die for a cantrip you cast using a {@item Staff|XPHB} as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB}, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll, even if the new roll is a 1 or a 2.

entries.name: Explosive Casting
entries: If all targets of a spell you cast using a {@item Staff|XPHB} as your {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB} are more than half the spell's range from you, one creature of your choice that you hit with a spell attack or that fails a saving throw against the spell has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

name: Stone Eyes
entries: Your Petrifying Gaze has come into its own. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Powerful Petrification
entries: If a creature that has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} or {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition as a result of one of your spells or your Medusa's Gift trait fails a saving throw to end the effect by 5 or more, you can choose to turn that creature to stone. Any magical effects causing the creature to have the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} or {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition end, and the creature has the {@condition Petrified|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. You must concentrate to maintain the effect. If you lose your {@status Concentration|XPHB}, the {@condition Petrified|XPHB} condition ends. If you maintain your {@status Concentration|XPHB} on the effect for the entire possible duration, the target is {@condition Petrified|XPHB} until the condition is ended by {@spell Greater Restoration|XPHB} or similar magic.

name: Stone-Hard
entries: The Dwarves were made to be strong to endure, for they came unto the world when a great evil ruled Middle-earth. As long as your spirit supports your strength you can resist any hurt of body more hardily than most.

items: When you are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. You cannot use this feature again until you finish a short or long rest.

name: Stout-Hearted
entries: Living for many a year under the ever-present menace of Smaug the Dreadful has made the Bardings a courageous race. After all, there are not many creatures more fearsome than a great Dragon...

items: You have advantage on Charisma saving throws, and you cannot be {@condition frightened} by non-undead creatures.

name: Strange as News from Bree
entries: It is indeed true that the affairs of the four villages are the chief concern of the Bree-folk, but the most inquisitive among the inhabitants are always ready to gather what tidings come from distant lands. You have learnt that listening to the strange tales that travellers often talk about can prove to be very precious.

items: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Investigation} skill. If you are already proficient, you add double your proficiency bonus to checks you make with it.
During each Fellowship Phase, you can receive a rumour from the Loremaster.

name: Strength of Will
entries: You have been raised in a land dotted with desolate ruins and burial mounds. You have heard the dead whisper with cold voices out of lonely barrows, while ghostly lights dance on haunted hills. When your will strengthens your heart, there is hardly anything in this world that can dismay you.

items: You have advantage on Charisma saving throws.
Whenever you must make a Charisma saving throw, you gain a bonus to the saving throw equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum +1).

name: Superior Discipline Acquisition (Animalism)
entries: The vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline is now second nature to you. You gain the following benefits.

You can expend 1 Blood Point to cast the {@spell Charm Monster|XPHB} or {@spell Dominate Beast|XPHB} spell. When you cast the spell in this way, the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the saving throw against the spell.

name: Superior Discipline Acquisition (Auspex)
entries: The vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline is now second nature to you. You gain the following benefits.

You can cast {@spell Detect Magic|XPHB} but only as a ritual. You can cast {@spell Clairvoyance|XPHB} and {@spell Telepathy|XPHB}. You can cast each of these spells without expending a spell slot. Once you cast either spell in this way, you can't cast that spell in this way again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Superior Discipline Acquisition (Celerity)
entries: The vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline is now second nature to you. You gain the following benefits.

As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend 1 Blood Point to gain an additional action. That action can be used to take only the {@action Attack|XPHB} (one attack only), {@action Dash|XPHB}, {@action Disengage|XPHB}, {@action Dodge|XPHB}, {@action Hide|XPHB}, or {@action Utilize|XPHB} action.

name: Superior Discipline Acquisition (Dominate)
entries: The vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline is now second nature to you. You gain the following benefits.

You can expend 3 Blood Points to cast the {@spell Mass Suggestion|XPHB} spell. When you cast the spell in this way, creatures have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the saving throw against the spell.

name: Superior Discipline Acquisition (Fortitude)
entries: The vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline is now second nature to you. You gain the following benefits.

When you take damage except Fire and Radiant, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to reduce the damage taken by your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} plus your Constitution modifier (minimum reduction of 1).

name: Superior Discipline Acquisition (Obfuscate)
entries: The vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline is now second nature to you. You gain the following benefits.

You can cast the {@spell Invisibility|XPHB} spell without expending a spell slot a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. In addition, when you gain the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition, you can expend up to 3 Blood Points to grant up to three other creatures that you can see within 30 feet of yourself the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. The number of Blood Points expended in this way equals the number of creatures affected by this feat.

name: Superior Discipline Acquisition (Oblivion)
entries: The vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline is now second nature to you. You gain the following benefits.

You can expend 2 Blood Points to cast the {@spell Evard's Black Tentacles|XPHB|Black Tentacles} spell. When you cast the spell in this way, the {@spell Evard's Black Tentacles|XPHB|Black Tentacles} deal {@damage 1d6} Bludgeoning damage and {@damage 2d6} Cold damage (instead of {@damage 3d6} Bludgeoning damage).

name: Superior Discipline Acquisition (Potence)
entries: The vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline is now second nature to you. You gain the following benefits.
As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend up to 6 Blood Points to increase your Strength score by an amount equal to the number of Blood Points expended in this way for 1 hour.

name: Superior Discipline Acquisition (Presence)
entries: The vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline is now second nature to you. You gain the following benefits.
You can cast the {@spell Suggestion|XPHB} spell without expending a spell slot.

name: Superior Discipline Acquisition (Protean)
entries: The vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline is now second nature to you. You gain the following benefits.

You can expend 1 Blood Point to cast the {@spell Meld into Stone|XPHB} spell on yourself. When you cast the spell in this way, the object or surface must be dirt, sand, or clay, and the spell's duration becomes 24 hours for that casting.

name: Superior Shifting
entries: You have a potent connection to the beast within, strengthening your body and your ability to shift. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Shifting Endurance
entries: At the start of your turn, you can use your Shifting trait (no action required). The transformation now lasts 10 minutes.

entries.name: Shifter Recovery
entries: You can use your Shifting trait one additional time. You regain 1 expended use when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, and all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Supreme Discipline Acquisition (Animalism)
entries: You have learned all you can about a vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline. You gain the following benefits.

You cast the {@spell Dominate Beast|XPHB} spell as its level 7 version without expending a spell slot, and you can modify it so that it doesn't require {@status Concentration|XPHB}. Once you cast the spell with this feat, you can't do so in this way again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Supreme Discipline Acquisition (Auspex)
entries: You have learned all you can about a vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline. You gain the following benefits.
You can expend 2 Blood Points to cast the {@spell True Seeing|XPHB} spell on yourself.

name: Supreme Discipline Acquisition (Celerity)
entries: You have learned all you can about a vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline. You gain the following benefits.

You can expend 2 Blood Points to cast the {@spell Haste|XPHB} spell on yourself. When you cast the spell in this way, when the spell ends, you aren't {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} and your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} isn't reduced to 0.

name: Supreme Discipline Acquisition (Dominate)
entries: You have learned all you can about a vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline. You gain the following benefits.

You cast the {@spell Dominate Person|XPHB} spell as its level 7 version without expending a spell slot, and you can modify it so that it doesn't require {@status Concentration|XPHB}. Once you cast the spell with this feat, you can't do so in this way again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Supreme Discipline Acquisition (Fortitude)
entries: You have learned all you can about a vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline. You gain the following benefits.

When you take damage except Fire and Radiant, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} and expend 2 Blood Points to reduce the damage you take by half (round down) or 4 Blood Points to reduce the damage to 0.

name: Supreme Discipline Acquisition (Obfuscate)
entries: You have learned all you can about a vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline. You gain the following benefits.

You can expend 1 Blood Point to cast the {@spell Greater Invisibility|XPHB} spell. When you cast the spell in this way, you can modify it so that it doesn't require {@status Concentration|XPHB}. In addition, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks.

name: Supreme Discipline Acquisition (Oblivion)
entries: You have learned all you can about a vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline. You gain the following benefits.

When a creature that you can see within 10 feet of you misses an attack roll, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} and expend 1 Blood Point to deal {@damage 2d8} Bludgeoning damage and {@damage 2d8} Cold damage to that creature.

name: Supreme Discipline Acquisition (Potence)
entries: You have learned all you can about a vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline. You gain the following benefits.

As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend 2 Blood Points to give yourself {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls using Strength for 1 minute. In addition, whenever you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on an attack roll using Strength, you can reroll one of the dice once.

name: Supreme Discipline Acquisition (Presence)
entries: You have learned all you can about a vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline. You gain the following benefits.

You can expend 3 Blood Points to cast the {@spell Sanctuary|XPHB} spell on yourself. When you cast the spell in this way, the spell doesn't end if you make an attack roll, cast a spell, or deal damage.

name: Supreme Discipline Acquisition (Protean)
entries: You have learned all you can about a vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline. You gain the following benefits.

You can expend 3 Blood Points to cast {@spell Polymorph|XPHB} on yourself, shape-shifting into a {@creature Bat|XMM}, {@creature Cat|XMM}, {@creature Rat|XMM}, {@creature Raven|XMM}, or {@creature Wolf|XMM}. You can expend 1 additional Blood Point to shape-shift into a {@creature Dire Wolf|XMM}, {@creature Giant Bat|XMM}, {@creature Giant Rat|XMM}, or {@creature Panther|XMM}. While in that form, you retain your Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores.

name: Sure at the Mark
entries: Hobbits are nimble and keen-eyed, qualities that make them good archers. You have honed this natural talent to perfection, so much so that you just need to stoop for a stone to find yourself armed with a deadly weapon.

items: You are proficient with improvised weapons.
When making a ranged attack with an improvised weapon, you can use your choice of your Strength or your Dexterity modifier for the attack and damage rolls.

As a bonus action, you can give yourself advantage on your next ranged attack roll on the current turn. You can use this bonus action only if you haven't taken reactions during this turn, and after you use the bonus action, you cannot take reactions until the start of your next turn.

name: Surtr's Touch
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Touch of Flame
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can imbue your touch with the power of fire for 1 minute. During that time, when you hit with a melee weapon attack, you deal extra Fire damage equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}. You can use this feat a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Survivor
entries: Your ability to make the best out of a bad situation has served you well. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Hardy
entries: You need half the amount of food per day based on your size.

entries.name: Intuitive
entries: When you take the {@action Study|XPHB} action, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Intelligence checks made when taking the {@action Study|XPHB} action.

entries.name: Shake It Off
entries: Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, your {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level, if any, decreases by 1. Additionally, when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, your {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level decreases by 2.

name: Swift Witchcraft
entries: You have honed your skills in the rituals of witchcraft and can quickly weave your magic in times of need. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Swift Invocation
entries: You can use an action to cast a spell that has a casting time of 1 minute. Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Syndicate Spy
entries: Rising in the ranks of the Ebon Syndicate has taught you the clandestine skills of spycraft, valuable in your trade as a racketeer. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Locksmith
entries: You have proficiency with {@item Thieves' Tools|XPHB}. While holding {@item Thieves' Tools|XPHB}, you can craft a key to a lock by spending 10 minutes with that lock.

entries.name: Master of Disguise
entries: You have proficiency with a {@item Disguise Kit|XPHB}. If you spend 10 minutes donning a {@item Costume|XPHB},  you decide what you look like, including your height, weight, facial features, sound of your voice, hair length, coloration, and other distinguishing characteristics. You can make yourself appear as a member of another species, though none of your statistics change. You can't appear as a creature of a different size, and your basic shape stays the same; if you're bipedal, you can't use this benefit to become quadrupedal, for instance.

entries.name: Master Calligrapher
entries: You have proficiency with a {@item Forgery Kit|XPHB}. You aren't limited to 10 or fewer words when mimicking someone else's handwriting.

entries.name: Blending In
entries: When using the {@action Hide|XPHB} action to conceal yourself from creatures that aren't {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} to you, you need only be {@variantrule Lightly Obscured|XPHB} and you may use Charisma instead of Dexterity for the check.

name: Tactical Combatant
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Buffering Strike
entries: When you hit a creature with a weapon, you can gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the total number rolled on the weapon's damage dice. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you roll {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} or finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Honed Instincts
entries: When you fail an ability check, you can roll {@dice 1d6} and add the number rolled to the ability check, potentially turning it into a success. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you roll {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} or finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Tellu and Scale's Master Cut

prerequisite.other: You must have beaten a master at Master Tellu and Scale's Sword School

entries: Having trained with the masters of the valley sword school, you have learned the usefulness of quickly changing between different fighting techniques in the midst of battle. You gain the following benefits:

items.name: One Handed
entries: While wielding a {@itemProperty V||versatile} weapon in one hand, your quick movements and agile defense allow you to regain ground even when your enemy advances. Once before the start of your next turn when you're missed by a melee attack from a creature within your reach, the attacker takes damage from your weapon equal to twice your proficiency bonus.

items.name: Two Handed
entries: When wielding a {@itemProperty V||versatile} weapon in two hands, your powerful stance allows you to catch your target off guard. Whenever an enemy within your reach makes a melee weapon attack against you and misses, you can use your reaction to attempt to knock the attacker off balance. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 + your Strength modifier + your proficiency bonus) or be knocked {@condition prone}.

name: The Art of Smoking
entries: You have mastered the art of smoking pipe-weed, and you always carry your {@item pipe|TLotRR} with you, as well as a bag of tobacco, for using it grants you patience and clarity of mind.

items: Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make with {@item pipe|TLotRR|pipes}.
You can use your {@item pipe|TLotRR} to gain inspiration a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, instead of once, before you need to finish a long rest.

name: The Kiss
entries: Your bite is intoxicating to your prey.

entries.name: Pleasurable Feeding
entries: When you feed, you can choose to roll d4s instead of d6s for your Feed Dice. When you do so, you regain 1 Blood Point on a roll of a 4 on the {@dice d4}, and the creature is {@condition Charmed|XPHB} by you. The {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition lasts until the end of your next turn.

name: The Language of Birds
entries: Stories told in the North say how Dalemen can become so wise as to comprehend the speech of birds, and so by understanding their song be forewarned of impending threats, or be able to spot a weakness in their enemies' defences.

items: You can comprehend and verbally communicate with birds, and you can obtain a magical success on any Intelligence ({@skill Nature}) and Wisdom ({@skill Animal Handling}) check related to birds.

When you are outside and you make an ability check, attack roll, or saving throw, you can do so with advantage. You can use this virtue a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

name: Thin-Blooded

otherSummary.entry: Can Be Chosen in Place of Any Origin Feat

entries: You have a portion of a vampire's blood flowing in your veins. You are a thin-blood, often destined for a place among the clanless. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Able to Feed
entries: You feed on the blood of other creatures. This is most often accomplished through your sharp fangs. As an action, you can feed on another creature within 5 feet of yourself if the target is willing, {@condition Charmed|XPHB} by you, or has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}, {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB}, {@condition Restrained|XPHB}, {@condition Stunned|XPHB}, or {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition. You can feed only once per turn.

You have {@dice 2d6} Feed Dice. When you feed, roll up to your maximum Feed Dice plus your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1). The creature takes Necrotic damage equal to the roll's total. This damage only reduces the creature's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum by an amount equal to the roll's total. If you roll a 6 on a {@dice d6} on a Feed Die, you can regain 1 expended Blood Point. If a creature's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum is reduced to 0, you can regain 1 expended Blood Point.

entries.name: Feeding from the Willing
entries: If you feed on a willing creature or a creature {@condition Charmed|XPHB} by you, it can spend 1 {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die}. It rolls the {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die} and reduces its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum by the amount rolled, and you can regain 1 expended Blood Point. Feeding in this way doesn't end the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition.

entries.name: Hit Die Deficit
entries: If a creature has no remaining {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB}, the creature takes Necrotic damage equal to a roll of your Feed Dice plus your Constitution modifier, and the creature's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the roll's total.

entries.name: Maximum Successful Feedings
entries: A creature can provide a number of Blood Points based on its size. A Small creature provides 1 Blood Point, a Medium provides 3, a Large provides 5, a Huge provides 7, and a Gargantuan provides 10. A creature regains all lost Blood Points when it finishes a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Creature Susceptible to Feed
entries: You can feed on any creature with blood or other life-giving fluid. Work with your GM to determine the types of creatures you can feed on.

entries.name: Kindred, but Not Kindred
entries: You ignore the Kindred class prerequisite for choosing {@filter Kindred feats|feats|category=kf}. You can't gain levels in the Kindred class.

entries.name: Kindred Vitae
entries: You have a number of Blood Points equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} minus one.

entries.name: Supernatural Spellcasting
entries: Charisma is your spellcasting ability for spells from your Kindred feats. Your spells require no Verbal or Somatic components, and they require no Material components unless they are consumed by the spell or have a cost specified in it. Taking damage can't break your {@status Concentration|XPHB} for spells cast using this feature.

name: Thoughtsinger
entries: You have honed your telepathic abilities, allowing you to link to and guide your companions as a united group. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Superior Telepathy
entries: The telepathy granted by your Mind Link trait has a range of 120 feet or 10 times your level, whichever is higher.

entries.name: Thoughtsong
entries: When you use your Mind Link trait to grant a creature the ability to speak to you telepathically, you form a mental connection with that individual. When you communicate telepathically, you may choose to send the message to all creatures you currently have a mental connection to. You may also allow those creatures to speak telepathically with one another. These effects last for as long as the Mind Link remains in effect.

entries.name: Telepathic Aid
entries: If you can speak telepathically to an ally using your Mind Link trait, you can take the {@action Help|XPHB} action to aid them in attacking a creature, even if you are more than 5 feet away from them.

name: Three is Company
entries: The Wise say that it is sometimes best to trust to friendship than to great wisdom. This is particularly true for Hobbits, as everyone knows that it is hardly possible to separate them from their friends. You have given your trust to your fellow Company members, and a true friendship has grown from the bond unifying you.

items: Increase the Fellowship rating of your Company by 1.

Whenever you or a companion you can see spend a Fellowship point, choose a number of companions (which can include yourself) who can see or hear you, up to your proficiency bonus. Each of those companions gains inspiration.

name: Thrown Arms Master
entries: You've honed your ability to lob weaponry into the fray, including weapons not meant for ranged combat. You gain the following benefits:

items: Simple and martial melee weapons without the thrown property have the {@itemProperty T|PHB|thrown} property for you. One-handed weapons have a normal range of 20 feet and a long range of 60 feet, while two-handed weapons have a normal range of 15 feet and a long range of 30 feet.
Weapons that already have the {@itemProperty T|PHB|thrown} property increase their short range by 20 feet and their long range by 40 feet for you.

When you miss with a thrown weapon attack using a light weapon, the weapon returns to your grasp like a boomerang at the end of your turn, unless something prevents it from returning. You can catch and stow as many weapons as you threw in this way.

name: Thrown Weapon Master
entries: You excel at thrown weapons. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Multithrow
entries: After you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action to make a ranged attack roll using a Simple weapon that has {@itemProperty T|XPHB|Thrown}, you can make two additional ranged attacks using Simple weapons that have {@itemProperty T|XPHB|Thrown} as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

entries.name: Quick Hands
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can retrieve and stow or wield all Simple weapons with {@itemProperty T|XPHB|Thrown} that are within 5 feet of you. You need a free hand to perform this maneuver.

entries.name: Returning
entries: Simple weapons with {@itemProperty T|XPHB|Thrown} that you are proficient with also have the {@itemMastery Returning|GrimHollowPG24} mastery property.

name: Toraf and Bolder's Master Cut

prerequisite.other: You must have beaten a master at Master Toraf and Bolder's Sword School

entries: Having trained with the masters of the mountain sword school, you've learned how to pull off difficult weapon maneuvers which allow you to target specific parts of a creature's anatomy. You gain the following benefits:

items.name: Head Strike
entries: Before you make a melee attack with a weapon that you are proficient with, you can choose to take a -5 penalty to the attack roll. If the attack hits, the target has disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

items.name: Torso Strike
entries: Before you make a melee attack with a weapon that you are proficient with, you can choose to take a -5 penalty to the attack roll. If the attack hits, the target can't speak until the start of your next turn, after which it is immune to the effects of Torso Strike for the next minute.

items.name: Leg Strike
entries: Before you make a melee attack with a weapon that you are proficient with, you can choose to take a -5 penalty to the attack roll. If the attack hits, the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet (to a minimum speed of 10 feet). This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.
You can only use one of these strikes per attack.

name: Touch of Darkness
entries: There is darkness within you, and it has given you a gift. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Eyes of Night
entries: You can see normally in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} and {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}—both magical and nonmagical—within 120 feet of yourself.

entries.name: Shadowplay
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks.

name: Tough as Old Tree-Roots
entries: They say that Hobbits are difficult to dismay or kill, and that they recover their health at a prodigious pace if allowed to enjoy some peace and quiet. You have discovered that you recover wonderfully from falls and bruises (at the cost of some considerable pain).

items: When you would roll one or more Hit Dice to regain hit points, you instead use the highest number possible for each die.

name: Triage Expert
entries: You are trained in dealing with injuries on the battlefield, and with the saving of lives afterward. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Bedside Manner
entries: Whenever you cause a creature to regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or the Blood and Bone benefit, you can roll one extra die and discard the lowest die.

entries.name: Blood and Bone
entries: Taking the {@action Utilize|XPHB} action and expending the use of a {@item Healer's Kit|XPHB} lets you heal a creature within 5 feet of you. The creature can expend and roll a {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die} and regain that number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

name: Trickster's Toolbox
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Tricksy Magic
entries: Choose two level 1 spells from the Enchantment or Illusion school of magic. You always have those spells and the {@spell Tasha's hideous laughter|XPHB|Hideous Laughter} spell prepared. You can cast each of these spells without expending a spell slot. Once you cast one of these spells in this way, you can't cast that spell in this way again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spells' spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.

name: Underfoot
entries: You can end your movement in a space occupied by a creature two sizes larger than you. If you attack that creature while you share its space, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on your attack roll. If that creature attacks you while it shares your space, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on its attack roll.

name: Unreflected
entries: Your image is separated from you, making you unable to cast a reflection or a shadow, but you're able to easily slip notice. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Inscrutable
entries: Creatures have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) checks made against you.

entries.name: Unremarkable
entries: The loss of some part of yourself leaves you able to fade into the background. While you are within a group of at least two other creatures of your type and that there are no more than one size larger or smaller than you, you can take the {@action Hide|XPHB} action from creatures outside that group by making a Charisma ({@skill Deception|XPHB}) check instead of Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}), with no need for being behind cover or {@variantrule Heavily Obscured|XPHB}. If you are ever more than 5 feet from at least two other such creatures while hiding this way, you are revealed.

name: Untameable Spirit
entries: Dwarves were made from their beginning to resist any form of domination. You have strengthened your resolve against all but the most subtle of the weapons of the Enemy.

items: You are immune to being {@condition charmed}.
You have advantage on Intelligence saving throws.

name: Uul Dhakaan
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Dreamwalker
entries: You remain fully lucid when you dream and when you wake, you clearly remember everything that transpired.

entries.name: Mentor in the Uul
entries: There is a spirit in the Uul Dhakaan that serves as your mentor. Work with your DM to develop the identity of this spirit; they could be the memory of an ancestor or fallen hero, or a living uul'kala bard. Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, there's a chance you'll receive a vision, a mission, or a clue about your current situation.

entries.name: Shielded by Dreams
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Psychic damage.

name: Virtue
entries: You gain a common or cultural virtue of your choice (see {@book Chapter 4|TLotRR|3|Virtues}).

name: Vitae Concentration
entries: Your body is more efficient at holding and processing vitae. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Increase Blood Pool
entries: Your Blood Point maximum increases by your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1).

name: Vital Sacrifice
entries: You've learned secrets of {@variantrule hemocraft|TalDoreiCampaignSettingReborn} that grant you esoteric power at the price of your own life force. As a bonus action, you can choose to take {@damage 1d6} necrotic damage to gain a blood boon. Your blood boon lasts for 1 hour or until expended.
You can expend this blood boon to gain one of the following benefits:

items: When you make an attack roll, you roll {@dice 1d6} and add it to the total.
When you hit with an attack or spell, you deal an additional {@damage 2d6} necrotic damage.
When you cause a creature to make a Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw}, roll a {@dice d4} and reduce their save by the amount rolled.

entries: The damage you take to gain a blood boon can't be reduced in any way.

name: Vocalist Arcanist
entries: Your unique method of weaving song into magic allows you to enhance your spells through your magical vocals. When you cast a spell that forces a target to make a saving throw or requires you to make a spell attack roll, you can choose to enhance the spell through song. You can wait until after you roll the {@dice d20} before deciding to use this, but must decide before the GM says whether the roll succeeds or fails.

When you do so, make a Charisma ({@skill Performance}) check. The DC for this check is equal to 10 + the spell's level. On a success, your proficiency bonus is doubled for the spell attack roll or your save DC for that casting of the spell.
Once you have succeeded on this check three times, you can't use this benefit again until the next dawn.

name: Voice of the Fury
entries: The mystical power of your voice grows stronger. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Innate Magic
entries: When you reach a character level specified in the Voice of the Fury Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared. You can cast each of these spells once without expending a spell slot, and you must finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} before you can cast them in this way again. You can also cast these spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.
Your spellcasting ability for these spells is the same as the spellcasting ability you chose for your Harpy's Charms trait.

name: Wand Expert
entries: You are adept with the use of {@item Wand|XPHB|Wands} as a swift {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB}. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Wand Mastery
entries: If you make a spell attack using a {@item Wand|XPHB} as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB}, you gain {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the attack roll if the target hasn't taken a turn.

entries.name: Unshakeable Casting
entries: When you make a ranged spell attack roll while using a {@item Wand|XPHB} as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB}, you do not have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the roll if you are within 5 feet of an enemy.

entries.name: Arcane Quickdraw
entries: Drawing or stowing a {@item Wand|XPHB} does not count against the number of object interactions you can take for free on your turn.

name: Wandslinger
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Arcane Aim
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls you make with spells.

entries.name: Mystic Force
entries: When you cast a cantrip that requires the target to make a saving throw, increase the DC of the saving throw by 1.

name: Warden Initiate
entries: You have learned some of the secrets and techniques of the Wardens of the Wood druidic order. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Warden's Proficiency.
entries: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Animal Handling|XPHB} skill.

entries.name: Protect Ally
entries: When a creature you can see hits another creature within 5 feet of you with an attack roll, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to reduce the damage dealt to the target by {@dice 1d6} + your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}.
Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Warden Spells
entries: The secrets you've learned allow you to always have certain spells at the ready. When you have spell slots of a level specified in the Warden of the Wood Spells table, you thereafter have the spells listed for that level and lower prepared.

name: Ways of the Wild
entries: The Rangers of the North roam ceaselessly, hunting for wicked things and guarding all frontiers. For you the Wild has become as familiar as the road that leads home is familiar to Hobbits, and the land itself may reveal useful tidings.

items: During a journey, you can take on multiple roles without penalties.

You gain proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: {@skill Explore|TLotRR}, {@skill Hunting|TLotRR}, or {@skill Travel|TLotRR}. If you are already proficient in each of them, you add double your proficiency bonus to checks you make with one of them of your choice.

When you make a Wisdom check using a skill in which you are proficient, you can obtain a magical success. You can do so a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

name: Weapon-Craft
entries: Choose a type of weapon. You gain proficiency with this weapon if you don't already have it.
